jobs.title: Sr. Customer Success Manager
jobs.sourceName: Jobicy: latest jobs
jobs.description:
About Firework

Join Firework – Where Innovation Meets Impact

Firework is revolutionizing connected commerce with the world’s most advanced and largest AI-powered video commerce platform, trusted by global brands and leading retailers. We bring the energy of in-store experiences online, transforming how businesses engage, convert, and build lasting customer relationships.

At Firework, you’ll be part of a high-growth, team-centric environment where innovation thrives and collaboration fuels success. Having raised over $235m to date led by investors such as the SoftBank Vision Fund 2 and operating at a global scale, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work cross-functionally, solve complex challenges, and drive meaningful impact in the future of connected digital commerce.

If you’re curious, ambitious, and energized by big ideas, Firework is the place to grow, lead, and shape the next era of online shopping—together.

Summary

Our team is responsible for offering strategic customer success relationship management to existing clients who leverage our innovative commerce solutions to drive their business growth. We’re looking for an experienced customer success professional to join our team to nurture and grow our enterprise customers across the North America market. You are client-focused, data-driven, and excited to establish and maintain close growth-oriented partnerships with a diverse portfolio.

What you’ll be doing

•
Own a portfolio of enterprise accounts across brands and retailers within the European region, serving as the primary strategic partner and building long-term, mutually beneficial customer relationships

•
Drive customer lifetime value by identifying expansion and cross-sell opportunities, mitigating churn risk, and partnering cross-functionally to support revenue growth

•
Own the end-to-end post-sale customer journey, including onboarding, integration, adoption, utilization analysis, ROI measurement, and strategic recommendations

•
Forecast, lead, and negotiate renewals and expansion opportunities to improve retention and net revenue retention, partnering closely with Sales and Revenue Operations

•
Serve as the voice of the customer, translating customer needs and feedback into actionable insights for Product and other cross-functional teams while driving measurable adoption outcomes

•
Analyze product usage, customer behavior, and performance data to deliver proactive insights, value-based recommendations, and personalized engagement strategies

•
Lead executive business reviews and strategic check-ins that clearly demonstrate business impact, ROI, progress against goals, and opportunities for continued growth

•
Manage day-to-day customer operations, including month-end billing review, internal coordination, issue resolution, and continuous improvement of customer processes and documentation

We’ll be excited if you have

•
Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience

•
7+ years of customer success, account management, or strategic relationship management experience supporting European enterprise customers, ideally within B2B SaaS

•
A proven track record of managing and improving commercial KPIs such as renewal rate, expansion, net revenue retention (NRR), and churn

•
Strong commercial and product acumen, with demonstrated experience contributing to customer growth and revenue outcomes

•
Strong technical aptitude and comfort using AI, analytics, and data tools to improve customer insights, efficiency, and decision-making

•
Experience with CRM and Customer Success platforms such as Salesforce and Gainsight is preferred

•
Exceptional attention to detail, strong prioritization skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced, startup environment

•
Excellent communication, relationship-building, and consultative skills, with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior executives

•
A balanced mix of analytical rigor, creativity, problem-solving, and customer empathy

•
Ability to work U.S. business hours

Compensation

Additional Information

Locations

The role will be remote. Preference will be for Eastern European based candidates.

Don’t hold back

We understand some candidates may see the above and not apply because they don’t meet all the qualifications. We encourage you to apply anyway; we often find talented candidates that fit many other opportunities we have and look for potential too, not just what you did in the past. As an equal employment opportunity employer, we are a diverse team that strives for an inclusive environment for all. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.sourceName: Jobicy: latest jobs
jobs.description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

About the role

We're looking for a Blockchain Intelligence Analyst to operate as a high-judgment, high-autonomy individual contributor specializing in transnational criminal organisations. You will use blockchain analytics, open-source and closed-source intelligence, and cryptocurrency attribution to trace the proceeds of drug trafficking, identify the networks that move them, and produce intelligence that helps TRM and its partners disrupt illicit drug activity.

This is not a people-management role. We're looking for an experienced analyst who can independently lead complex investigations, develop high-confidence assessments, uncover novel attribution, and raise the team's tradecraft through technical expertise and example. This role will require proactive work with law enforcement partners, often picking up a stalled investigation, finding what was missed, and linking it to other cases.

You should be equally comfortable tracing funds across blockchains, identifying laundering and cash-out infrastructure, correlating on-chain and off-chain signals, and turning fragmented data into clear, defensible intelligence that enables partners to make informed operational decisions.

The impact you will have

•
Produce finished intelligence on transnational criminal organisations, vendors, facilitators and laundering pathways, including actor profiles, lead packages and attribution assessments suitable for investigative, executive and partner audiences.

•
Lead complex end-to-end blockchain investigations from initial seed indicators, such as addresses, transactions, exchange exposure and infrastructure leads, through to full attribution.

•
Trace illicit proceeds across multiple blockchains, bridges, mixers, peel chains and nested services, identifying controllers, counterparties and cash-out points, including OTC desks, ATM networks and cash-to-crypto services.

•
Correlate on-chain activity with OSINT, closed-source intelligence and off-chain identity or infrastructure signals to build a complete picture of how transnational criminal organisations operate and move value.

•
Own investigative work-streams from discovery through validation and written production, drafting intelligence that is source-cited, auditable and operationally useful.

•
Build and maintain strong working relationships with law enforcement partners, so that our intelligence reflects real investigative tradecraft and gets used.

•
Help strengthen TRM's transnational criminal organisations coverage by contributing new attributions, refining investigative methodology and improving repeatable workflows.

•
Support briefings, partner engagements and capability-building sessions where tracing and attribution tradecraft must be explained clearly and credibly.

What success looks like

•
You generate meaningful attribution and investigative leads in cases where the answers are not obvious and the financial trail is deliberately obscured.

•
You consistently produce finished intelligence that partners trust and use.

•
Your work helps TRM and its partners move faster on high-priority narcotics activity without sacrificing rigor, auditability or defensibility.

•
You improve team capability by mentoring peers, refining tradecraft and strengthening repeatable workflows.

What we're looking for

•
Professional experience: 5+ years in blockchain intelligence, crypto investigations, financial-crime or narcotics investigations, threat intelligence, or a comparable senior analytical role.

•
Blockchain tracing expertise: deep hands-on experience tracing funds across multiple blockchains and through laundering or obfuscation techniques such as mixers, chain-hopping, bridges, peel chains and layered cash-out behavior.

•
Investigative tradecraft: demonstrated ability to independently run complex investigations and synthesize findings into clear written intelligence products, including assessments, lead packages, fund-flow analysis and attribution reporting.

•
Strong communication: especially the ability to turn technically complex findings into understandable, actionable intelligence for government and private-sector audiences.

Judgment and execution: sound judgment and curiosity, and the ability to operate in a fast-moving environment where outputs must still stand up to scrutiny.

•
AI fluency: experience using AI tools and large language models to accelerate research and augment analytical workflows, with the ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy and relevance.

jobs.title: Staff Security Engineer
jobs.sourceName: Jobicy: latest jobs
jobs.description:
The role

Our InfoSec team is looking for a Staff Security Engineer to lead how we defend Paddle in a rapidly changing threat landscape. AI is changing both sides of security. Attackers are using it to scale social engineering, find weaknesses faster and automate intrusion, while our own adoption of AI tools and agents creates new risks to manage. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for an experienced security generalist who wants to build our defences against these threats, and to use automation and AI to make our detection and response faster and more effective. You’ll be a senior technical leader across InfoSec and IT, working across both our Enterprise IT and Product environments, and helping our global team of Paddlers operate securely without slowing them down.

What you’ll do

•
Lead our incident response capability, from playbooks and readiness exercises to acting as senior technical lead during security incidents.

•
Improve our security operations, strengthening detection coverage, alert quality and triage, and turning manual operational work into engineered, repeatable processes.

•
Build and evolve our defences against AI-enabled threats, including AI-driven phishing, impersonation and deepfakes, and accelerated vulnerability exploitation.

•
Help Paddle grow our adoption of AI securely by designing guardrails, access models and monitoring for AI tools and agents, including the non-human identities and integrations they rely on.

•
Use automation and AI to speed up detection, investigation and response, so the team can handle a growing threat volume without growing headcount at the same rate.

•
Contribute to the secure configuration, posture management and monitoring of our AWS cloud infrastructure, working with the Platform team so security initiatives are delivered in a scalable and reliable manner.

•
Strengthen identity and access security as capabilities evolve, including our approach to MFA, device trust and conditional access.

•
Support GRC initiatives on technical control implementation and audit evidence automation, in line with SOC 2, PCI DSS and CIS Benchmarks.

•
Partner with InfoSec, IT and Engineering leadership to set technical direction and deliver the department’s key security programmes, making design decisions and driving work across multiple business functions.

•
Mentor and support other engineers across InfoSec, IT and the wider Engineering function, building a culture of continuous improvement, knowledge sharing and technical excellence.

Skills & Experience

At Paddle we value a growth mindset and a willingness to learn, so if you're confident in most of these skills (not necessarily all) and you're excited to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We’d love to hear from you if you:

•
Have extensive experience as a security engineer or in a similar role, with breadth across incident response, security operations, security engineering and cloud security, and a strong track record of hands-on delivery.

•
Have led or played a senior role in responding to real security incidents, from investigation and containment through to recovery and lessons learned.

•
Bring strong cloud security expertise, including identity, resource configuration, logging and monitoring. Hands-on experience securing AWS, including containerised workloads and cloud-native deployments, is highly desirable.

•
Have experience with detection and response tooling, such as SIEM, EDR and cloud security posture management platforms, and know how to make them effective rather than noisy.

•
Understand how AI is changing the threat landscape, and are excited about using automation and AI to improve how security teams detect, investigate and respond.

•
Are familiar with modern identity, device management and endpoint security solutions (e.g. Okta, Iru, Island, SentinelOne), as well as collaboration and networking tools (e.g. Google Workspace, Slack, Cloudflare Zero Trust).

•
Can script or program to automate workflows and integrate systems. Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform preferred) is desirable.

•
Have experience implementing technical controls against frameworks such as SOC 2, PCI DSS or CIS Benchmarks (nice to have).

•
Are comfortable operating autonomously on high-impact, wide-reaching work, and working collaboratively across multiple business functions.

•
Can communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and are comfortable influencing at all levels of the business, including during high-pressure incidents.

•
Are passionate about security and want to make a real impact at scale.

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. We are looking for a smart, ambitious, and autonomous Business Development Representative to help fuel our next stage of hyper-growth. The Strategic Project Lead – Speech & Audio will sit in Appen's Operations organization and support the development of frontier AI through high-quality data programs for leading AI companies. We’re looking for someone with experience in speech, audio, or language data to own complex projects from planning through delivery.

You’ll combine project management, domain expertise, and quality ownership to help clients build and improve speech recognition systems, voice agents, and other AI applications. You’ll work closely with clients and internal teams to solve problems, refine workflows, and keep pace with a rapidly evolving AI landscape.

Your Impact

• Own end-to-end delivery across project scope, timelines, budgets, staffing, and risks.

• Manage client communication, status updates, workshops, and escalations.

• Translate client requirements into annotation guidelines, workflows, tooling, and quality standards.

• Define and monitor quality metrics, including transcription accuracy, word error rate (WER), diarization, and linguistic consistency.

• Troubleshoot quality issues and resolve ambiguous requirements with clients.

• Provide domain expertise across speech and audio workflows, advising on feasibility, evaluation methods, and tooling.

• Build reusable guidelines, SOPs, and QA frameworks while mentoring Operations Specialists.

• Support new project scoping, pilots, and capability development as speech and voice AI evolves.

What You Bring

• 1–2+ years of experience in AI data operations, project coordination, or delivery, ideally in a GenAI or frontier AI environment.

• Hands-on familiarity with at least one speech, audio, language, or conversational AI workflow.

• Experience coordinating projects or workstreams, managing stakeholders, and communicating with clients.

• Understanding of data quality, annotation workflows, and quality assurance methods.

• Ability to turn client requirements into clear guidelines, workflows, and quality standards.

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

• Interest in current AI developments and how speech, audio, and voice-agent technologies are evolving.

Nice to Have

• Experience with ASR transcription, speaker diarization, acoustic annotation, or TTS evaluation.

• Familiarity with voice-agent scripts, IVR, dialogue design, turn-taking, or conversational evaluation.

• Experience with localization, cross-locale consistency, CJK languages, or low-resource languages.

• Bilingual or multilingual capabilities, particularly German or a Nordic language.

Why You'll Love Working Here

At Appen, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. We value curiosity, accountability, and a commitment to delivering the highest quality AI solutions for frontier models.

You'll work on complex challenges that shape the future of AI across industries and geographies, alongside talented people in a culture that values humility over ego. Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X .

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity:

We’re looking for an enthusiastic, tech-forward product marketer to grow our Observability products by boldly positioning them and running campaigns to attract, convert and retain customers. As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will be in charge of the messaging and positioning for a broad product area. Then you’ll work closely with product managers and the marketing team to deliver campaigns, content, events, and training that help buyers buy (and sellers sell) our value.

Product Marketing lives within the Product org rather than the Marketing org at Grafana Labs, and we think differently about the job. Rather than purely executing launches or campaigns, we want PMMs to teach product managers and engineers in our org how to think about growth and demand, and to codify product marketing knowledge into AI-forward tools and processes that anyone in the organization can use. For example, we all contribute product information to a shared knowledge base, which we use to generate enablement materials and decks.

Grafana Labs is a fast-paced and growing organization. As such, this role requires strategic skills, an interest in teaching, and hands-on tactical execution (blogs, webinar outlines, video scripts, etc). Our team is full of people who crave impact and independence - if you are seeking a role with narrow scope where you run a defined playbook, this is not the job for you.

What You'll Be Doing:

• Actively partner with and teach product managers to define product value, messaging, and go-to-market strategy, from competitive positioning to sales enablement collateral.

• Partner with product management, engineering and various go-to-market functions to create materials that help customers evaluate and adopt our products: reference architectures, implementation guides, detailed product information and more.

• Own customer lifecycle campaigns (competitive positioning, retention, upsell/cross-sell) to strategically shape marketing programs and drive growth across the entire customer journey.

• Conduct market and customer research to understand pain points, competition and opportunities.

• Teach go-to-market and sales teams our products’ capabilities and the value they provide, deliver training and enablement, ensure customer facing teams are able to effectively engage with customers, partners, and prospects.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

• 4+ years of relevant experience (product marketing, solutions marketing, product management)

• Experience with marketing and selling to a technical audience

• A passion for open source, cloud native, and infrastructure technologies

• Proven ability to take on complex projects and efficiently drive them from start to finish

• Ability to clearly articulate the value of technical products to customers and sellers alike

• Experience leading product or feature launches autonomously as well as part of a team

• Experience working with AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude to automate messaging and workflows

• Comfort working with a variety of internal and external stakeholders in complicated processes

• Strong product and technical curiosity that translate to clear packaging, positioning, and messaging

• Demonstrated quantitative analytical skills for analyzing campaign performance, evaluating lifecycle metrics, and making data-driven recommendations.

• Exceptional writing and communication skills

• A high “say-do” ratio in executing and delivering impact

This position can be offered fully home-based within Germany.

• You are calm, thoughtful, and responsive when things don’t go as planned.

• You are well-prepared, whether it be for an investigator meeting, site visit or project team update, always staying two steps ahead of the game.

• You find quick and creative ways of overcoming difficulties.

• You have an impeccable eye for detail.

• You identify potential study risks and propose solutions on how to mitigate them.

• You take responsibility in the quality and outcomes of your work.

• You are adept at handling conflict by using tried and true resolution strategies.

• 4-year college degree or equivalent experience

• Holder of CRA certificate

• Availability for domestic travel including overnight stays, which may constitute up to approximately 50-60% travel commitment (international travel may be required for some senior level positions)

• Fluency in English and the local language is required

• Additional language(s) will be considered an asset

• Graduate or postgraduate degree with a concentration in a scientific or healthcare discipline

• Study start up activities experience

At Precision for Medicine, we combine the agility and collaboration of a specialized CRO with the scientific expertise needed to support innovative clinical development programmes. Principal Product Manager, Agentic AI

REMOTE, United States

JOB OVERVIEW

Legion is building AI agents that carry out workforce management work, not agents that describe it.

Much of what is presented as AI in workforce management today is a conversational layer over an existing scheduling screen. The more substantial problem — software that reasons over demand, labor regulation, and employee preferences, then acts, with a person in the loop wherever the stakes require one — remains unsolved across the category. Legion intends to solve it, and this role leads the product work to get there.

You will take an agent surface from operational research through specification, prototype, evaluation, and enterprise deployment, working hands-on throughout. You will work closely with Legion's AI Lab engineers and with our CEO, who is engaged in this work daily.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

Agent definition. Determine what an agent is responsible for, which tools it may call, what it must escalate, what it must never do, and what a manager sees when it acts. These decisions affect employee pay and legal compliance. Much of this work is pre-launch, so you will shape the direction rather than inherit it.

Problem selection. The hardest judgment in agentic product work is identifying which workflows suit an agent and which do not. You will spend substantial time inside customer operations — district managers, store managers, labor operations, frontline employees — and return with a ranked, defensible view of where an agent creates measurable value and where it does not.

The human-in-the-loop contract. Scheduling decisions affect income, childcare arrangements, and legal protections. For each agent action you will define where autonomy is appropriate, the escalation thresholds, how a manager overrides the system, what is logged, and how a compliance team audits the outcome. Legion treats this as a first-class design problem.

Build quality. You are accountable for what ships, not for what was specified. That means staying engaged through implementation: reviewing the build against the specification as it comes together, using the product yourself before anyone else is asked to, joining bug triage and design review, catching drift from intent while it is still cheap to correct, and holding a release when the quality is not there. Our customers experience the build, not the document. A well-written specification that produced a product managers do not trust is failed product work, and we assess it that way.

Evaluation. Build and maintain the evaluation sets that determine whether an agent is ready to ship and whether it is degrading in production — writing the cases, reviewing failure traces, setting the pass criteria. You will be the person who holds a release when the demonstration is persuasive and the evaluation is not.

Specifications. Legion uses Functional Requirements Documents as its ground-truth specification layer; release notes, enablement material, and sales content are generated from maintained specifications rather than reconstructed from code or institutional memory. Write FRDs that meet that standard and keep them accurate after release. A specification is where the work begins, not where your responsibility ends.

Commercialization. Partner with go-to-market on packaging, metering, pricing inputs, and field readiness. Agentic products raise difficult commercial questions — what unit to meter, what a customer is paying for when software performs work a person previously did — and you will be expected to hold a considered position on them.

Design-partner delivery. Lead agent deployments with large enterprise design partners: scoping the pilot, establishing success criteria before it begins, joining failure reviews, and determining what becomes generally available and what remains bespoke.

TECHNICAL EXPECTATIONS

Legion is looking for a product manager who builds, rather than one who directs others who build. In a typical week, this role involves:

• Writing and iterating on prompts and system prompts directly, and explaining why a change improved a behavior

• Standing up a working prototype of a proposed agent — tool definitions, structured outputs, retries, guardrails — before engineering is asked to build anything

•
You host a live, one-hour workshop (seminar-style) for students

•
You are paid $50 per workshop , plus any private coaching business you acquire

•

• Become an expert in managing your sales pipeline in Salesforce

• 5+ Years of experience in infrastructure technology sales

• Demonstrated history of consistent goal achievement in a highly competitive environment (top 10% performer)

About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team:

Upstart’s Secured Lending Quality team is responsible for building and operating the first line of defense quality control program across Upstart’s secured lending products, including Home Lending and Auto Lending. The team ensures loans meet high standards for accuracy, compliance, and salability through a multi-layered quality framework spanning origination, servicing, collections, and non-performing loan monitoring. The team operates independently from production management, providing credible challenges to the business while using AI-powered technology to deliver scalable, examination-ready quality assurance.

As the Secured Lending Quality Manager, you will lead quality control execution across the secured product portfolio, including pre-close and post-close reviews, compliance monitoring and testing, servicing and collections quality reviews, non-performing loan reviews, and investor defect analysis. You will serve as a key leader in strengthening Upstart’s quality infrastructure, partner closely with Operations, Compliance, Legal, and Risk, and help scale a modern, data-driven quality program in a fast-moving lending environment. This is an opportunity for an experienced quality leader who is energized by building programs from the ground up and improving how quality is measured, monitored, and operationalized across the secured lending lifecycle.

How you’ll make an impact

• Lead execution of Upstart’s secured lending quality control program across origination, servicing, and collections, including pre-close and post-close reviews, compliance testing, denied/withdrawn application reviews, investor defect analysis, and non-performing loan reviews

• Oversee QC sampling methodology and ensure risk-based, statistically sound sample selection aligned with regulatory expectations

• Serve as product owner for the QC Engine, including rule approval, output validation, threshold calibration, and performance reporting

• Drive root cause analysis and remediation for defect trends, investor kickouts, repurchase demands, early payment defaults, and other quality issues

• Develop quality reporting, dashboards, and trend analyses for senior leadership, including defect trends, escape rates, cure rates, sampling coverage, and corrective action status

• Prepare the Quality function for audits and regulatory exams through strong documentation, evidence management, and examination-ready processes

• Partner with Operations, Compliance, Legal, Risk, and servicing teams to align on quality standards, escalation paths, and remediation timelines

• Oversee third-party, subservicer, servicing, and collections quality reviews, including compliance with applicable consumer lending requirements

• Support model risk monitoring through quality reviews tied to credit decisioning, adverse action accuracy, and early default trends

Minimum Qualifications

• 7+ years of experience in quality control, compliance testing, or risk management in consumer lending, including secured lending products such as mortgage, home equity, or auto

• 2+ years of experience leading a QC team or managing quality analysts or auditors

• Experience conducting pre-close and post-close file reviews, defect identification, root cause analysis, and corrective action management

• Experience with regulatory exams and responses involving agencies such as the OCC, FDIC,

jobs.description:

Senior Director, Revenue Accounting

Bitwarden is looking for a Sr. Director of Revenue Accounting to own how we recognize, record, and report revenue across both self-service and sales-assisted channels. This leader is accountable for the full revenue cycle, from contract and invoice through cash and recognized revenue. You will own our revenue stack (Stripe, HubSpot, and Rillet) end to end and partner closely with Sales, Legal, FP&A, and Engineering.

What You'll Own:

• Own end-to-end order to cash operations for both self-service (PLG, credit card, via Stripe) and sales-assisted (enterprise, multi-year, custom contract) revenue streams.

• Own revenue recognition under ASC 606 for self-service and sales-assisted contracts, including performance obligations, standalone selling price, contract modifications, multi-year and ramped deals, usage-based components, and channel or reseller arrangements.

• Own deferred revenue, revenue schedules, and the monthly revenue close in Rillet, and deliver accurate revenue results to Corporate Accounting for month-end close.

• Design billing and revenue processes for large, complex transactions: multi-entity contracts, custom pricing, mid-term upgrades and downgrades, true-ups, and co-terming, from HubSpot deal creation through Stripe invoicing to Rillet recognition.

• Own the data flow and reconciliation across HubSpot, Stripe, and Rillet, including the bookings to billings to revenue reconciliation, the deferred revenue rollforward, and AR subledger to general ledger tie-outs.

• Own sales tax compliance across all channels, including nexus monitoring, tax calculation and collection in Stripe, exemption certificate management, return filing and remittance, and audit readiness, in partnership with external tax advisors.

• Write technical accounting memos for non-standard enterprise contracts and review them with external auditors.

• Own SOX controls for the revenue cycle and serve as the main contact for audit fieldwork on revenue.

• Define and monitor KPIs: billing accuracy, days sales outstanding, dunning/failed payment recovery rate, invoice cycle time, and dispute rates.

• Partner with Sales to structure non-standard enterprise deals so they translate cleanly into accurate, compliant billing in Stripe.

• Own sales commission accounting and administration, including commission calculations and payouts, ASC 340-40 capitalization and amortization of commission costs, and accrual accuracy, and partner with Sales leadership, FP&A, and HR on commission plan design, quota and attainment rules, and the cost and controls impact of plan changes.

• Drive Stripe configuration and automation (subscription schedules, proration rules, dunning/failed payment recovery, invoicing rules) to reduce manual touch on high-volume self-service billing.

• Partner with SalesOps to own the HubSpot-to-Stripe-to-Rillet data pipeline — ensuring deal terms, billing events, and revenue entries stay in sync, and closing gaps with native integrations, middleware, or custom tooling as needed.

• Collaborate with Product/Engineering on Stripe/product OTC enhancements, new pricing models, and packaging changes.

• Lead, mentor, and scale a billing, collections and commission teams (analysts, specialists, managers) as transaction volume and deal complexity grow.

What We're Looking For:

• 10+ years of accounting experience, including 5+ years in SaaS revenue accounting and 3+ years leading teams.

• CPA or equivalent public accounting experience

• Deep, hands-on ASC 606 experience for SaaS, including large and non-standard enterprise transactions: custom terms, multi-year deals, usage-based or hybrid pricing, amendments, and co-terming.

• Experience accounting for both self-service (high-volume, automated, credit-card-based) and sales-assisted (contract-based, high-value) revenue.

• Experience with SOX, external audit management, and building controls in a growing company.

• Experience managing billing, collections, or order-to-cash teams, and commission

• Track record of building scalable processes and automating manual workflows, including integrations between CRM, billing, and accounting systems.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills; comfortable in ambiguity and fast-changing environments.

In the United States, the starting base compensation range for this role is $200,000 - $225,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, relevant experience, and skill set as assessed in the interview process, as well as market data by location. See our careers page for a list of benefits.

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

So what is the role, exactly?

We’re looking for an empathetic, tech-savvy communicator with exceptional attention to detail to join our customer care team. You’ll guide and support families through one of their most vulnerable times. It’s no stretch to say this is one of the most important roles in the company.

This is a phone-based role, helping families arrange in-home euthanasia and pet cremation. You’ll take the time to listen, show them you care, and coordinate and communicate every step of the process.

That makes sense, but what would my day to day look like?

Families come to us looking for guidance, empathy and support as they arrange their pet’s end-of-life care. Each day, you’ll be:

•
Answering a high volume of inbound calls.

•
Offering thoughtful guidance as families consider the right time to say goodbye.

•
Being a trusted guide throughout the arrangement process.

•
Navigating multiple online systems with speed and accuracy.

•
Liaising with our veterinary team to find available appointment times.

•
Coordinating with our crematorium team and external partners to arrange services.

•
Supporting multiple families at once, following a structured workflow so every family receives the same outstanding care. The ability to multitask is a must!

You’ll report to our Customer Support Team Leader and work alongside a team of amazing, like-minded people.

OK, sounds great. Who are you looking for?

This is a hard but incredibly impactful role. Families come to us in all kinds of circumstances, trusting us to guide them through a difficult part of their lives.

You’ll need:

•
A genuine desire to offer empathy and support to pet parents from all walks of life.

•
Confidence guiding people who need thoughtful, non-judgemental support.

•
The ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

•
Comfort using technology and following processes.

•
The ability to take the lead in a conversation and build trust.

Most importantly, we want someone who believes in our mission. Everyone at Goodbye Good Boy is driven by the impact of our work, and we want that to continue with every person who joins our team.

We operate seven days a week, supporting families from 7am–8:30pm Monday to Saturday and 8am–6pm Sunday (AEST).

You must be available for at least four eight-hour shifts per week, including Saturdays, plus a rotating Sunday shift at least one in every three weekends. Ideally available for 30 hours per week.

What’s in it for me?

We’re a passionate team on a mission to bring positive change to the pet end-of-life industry. We’re incredibly proud of our work, celebrate our many milestones, and take immense pride in the difference we make for the families we have the privilege to serve.

The main reason you’ll join, though, is because you believe in what we do and are excited to help transform an industry.

Sound like you? Apply now with your CV and a cover letter telling us why you want to be part of Goodbye Good Boy.

• You've produced customer stories people actually watch, and you know how to run a great interview.

• You've shipped on a small budget with contractors and can say what each piece cost.

• You've built content at an early-stage company, ideally Series A to C, and want to build from scratch again.

Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own. Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day.

About MetaMask & Trade

MetaMask is a self-custodial wallet used by tens of millions of people. In Trade, people swap, bridge, trade perps, predict and earn. Core UX is the part of MetaMask mobile that sit inside: Home, the navigation, balances, tokens and positions, and the path from the first screen into each of them.

People open the app and land on Home. If that screen is slow, crowded, or unclear about what to do next, Swap, Perps, Predict and Earn see fewer of the people who opened the app. The surface is live. You start from the app people already have, and you keep shipping on it.

The role is Staff Product Manager, Core UX. You write the vision for Home and the navigation, and you run the build with design and engineering. A design background is a requirement, because the work is the screen itself.

The Role

You are the product manager for Core UX on MetaMask mobile. You own the vision, the roadmap and the backlog for Home and the navigation, and you own whether that screen is working.

You will work closely with:

• The Core UX engineering team

• Design

• Data and analytics

• The product managers for Swap, Perps, Predict and Earn

Those products show up on Home. You own how a person reaches them from there, and how their balances and positions show up. Their roadmaps stay with their product managers. Yours is Home and the navigation.

The app is already live and people open it every day, so you start from what is there. You walk design leadership through the screen, and you are in the reviews where the layout gets decided.

What You'll Do

Set the Core UX vision

Write what Home is for, who has to succeed on it, and what it shows before anyone taps. Getting back to an open position has to be fast for people who already trade here. A first install still has to reach one real action in that same session.

Write down where a MetaMask person would already know what to tap, and where one of those apps does something we should study. Then write the roadmap, with the tradeoffs and the order, and what each step changes on Home.

Own Home, the navigation and the defaults

Own what a person sees when they open the app. That is balances, tokens and positions, and the way into Swap, Perps, Predict and Earn. A balance, a token, a position and an entry point are different, and Home has to show each one in a place the person can find.

Decide what Home shows before anyone taps. Anything past that waits until the person opens it. Put Swap, Perps and Predict close together for people who use more than one of them. A person using only one of those products still has to be able to finish their action.

Search and any assistance that sits on Home are part of this surface. You specify what stays on the screen, and what the person still confirms before money moves.

Get people to a first action, and get them to come back

You own the first session and the return after it. Count how many new wallets take a real action, and how many of those people open the app again. Define the path from the open to a confirmed action, and instrument it.

Review screens with design

You have a design background, and the role uses it. You review screens for hierarchy, type, spacing and what a tap does. You mark up a screen and say what should change, in writing, so design and engineering can build from the note.

You write the product point of view clearly enough that design and engineering can build it. You are in the design reviews. A crowded screen, or a tap that does the wrong thing, gets the specific change you want.

Work with the products that live on Home

Each MetaMask trade primitive already has their own product manager. You own the entry from Home and the way their positions and balances read there. When a change to Home helps one product and hurts another, you name the tradeoff in the spec.

You coordinate the sequencing when a Home change depends on one of those teams, or when one of their launches depends on Home. The spec says what Home will show on the day their change ships.

Run the work

You take a problem through spec, design, build, test and launch, and then you read what happened. You run planning and the backlog with the Core UX engineering team.

You build things, break things, explain things, and keep going until the thing you’re working on has a name.

You’re comfortable speaking at conferences and just as comfortable digging through an API, a GitHub issue, or a weird networking edge case until it makes sense. You’re probably the kind of person who runs a local AI model in your homelab and can explain exactly why. You ask “why does it work that way?” often, and your instinct is to make the answer clearer, simpler, and better for the next developer.

At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀

Everything we build now runs through one question: how do we supercharge productivity with AI?
ClickUp Brain and our agentic AI capabilities are the center of gravity for the company. We're not bolting AI onto a project management tool, we're building the platform where AI does real work: drafting, summarizing, routing, researching, and executing alongside the humans who use it. That focus is external and internal. We expect our customers to get radically more productive with AI, and we expect the same of ourselves. Every ClickUp employee is given the tools, the training, and the mandate to use AI in their daily workflow.

This is an AI-native role. You will use AI every day to research faster, personalize at scale, prep calls, and keep your pipeline clean. You will also be selling AI, so you need to speak about it credibly.

The Role
As a Market Development Representative (MDR), you'll serve as the critical bridge between our marketing efforts and the sales team, playing a pivotal role in accelerating our revenue pipeline. You will be responsible for meticulously following up on, nurturing, and qualifying all inbound leads generated from our diverse marketing channels. This role is fundamental to ensuring our sales team engages only with the most promising and well-prepared prospects.

In this position, you'll act as the first point of contact and a trusted educator for potential customers. Your mission is to understand their initial interest, assess their business needs, and articulate the value of our platform, including how our AI capabilities change what their team is capable of. You will manage the crucial early stages of the buyer's journey, building rapport and filtering for high-potential opportunities before seamlessly transitioning them to an Account Executive.

This is a high-velocity motion: sub-30 day cycles, pipeline generation at scale, and relentless execution. MDRs don't win by out-strategizing over weeks. They win by out-hustling, out-qualifying, and out-persisting, turning every inbound signal into a qualified opportunity that sticks downstream.

How We Hire, Coach and Measure: The Four Pillars
Every MDR is developed and evaluated against four behavioral pillars. They're not corporate values on a wall, they're the operating system of the team.

🔥 Ownership. The non-negotiable foundation. Extreme ownership of pipeline outcomes and no excuses when a lead goes cold because you didn't respond fast enough or log your work properly. Intellectual honesty: truth over ego. Going above and beyond for the team's collective success, not just your own number.

⭐️ Obsession. The refusal to plateau. This is a high-rejection motion, so you study objection patterns, perfect talk tracks, and learn from every no. You compound knowledge: every call makes the next one better because you document what works and share it.

⚡️ Effectiveness. Winning by design, not effort alone. Converting high volume into high quality through sharp qualification, deep discovery, and meetings that actually stick. Every touch is chosen for maximum conversion impact.

🤖 AI Native. Using AI to amplify your own output, and positioning ClickUp's AI credibly to prospects. The bar: you're leveraging AI across research, outreach, follow-up, and CRM hygiene, and you can articulate our agentic AI value proposition in every qualification conversation.

Key Responsibilities

• Respond promptly (Zoom, phone, email) to all inbound leads generated by marketing activities: handraisers, account signals, content, webinars, social campaigns, and events.

• Qualify marketing-qualified leads (MQLs) using a consistent framework to determine sales readiness and fit, and distinguish buyers from browsers.

• Nurture leads through in-depth conversations, acting as an educator and advisor rather than focusing solely on immediate conversions.

• Uncover real business pain beneath surface-level inquiries, quantify its impact, and document it clearly for the AE.

• Position ClickUp's platform and agentic AI capabilities credibly and specifically, mapping them to the prospect's actual workflow gaps.

• Use AI tools across your entire workflow: account and persona research, personalization at scale, call prep, follow-up drafting, and CRM hygiene. Edit every output for authenticity, never ship raw.

Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States

In 1933, Harry Beck introduced a radically different map of the London Underground. Rather than faithfully depicting the geography of London, he simplified the sprawling transit network into clean lines, clear connections, and a system that anyone could navigate. Distances were distorted, angles were standardized, and unnecessary details disappeared. The result was something far more useful than a geographically accurate map: a way for millions of people to understand a complex system and confidently find their way through it.

Beck understood something fundamental. The best way to explain something complicated isn't to show people everything. It's to understand what matters to them and make that unmistakably clear.

At Mercury, we believe great product marketing works the same way. Banking* and payments can be complex, but the value they create for customers shouldn't be. Our job is to understand what people need, find the essence of what we're building, and help customers see how it can make their lives better.

We're a financial technology company building products that help ambitious businesses do more with their money. From everyday banking and payments to international money movement and emerging capabilities like agentic payments, we're making complex financial workflows feel remarkably simple.

We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager to help bring these products to market, communicate their value, and make sure customers discover and use what we're building.

Headquarters: Remote

Cadence is the clinical AI company automating the treatment of chronic disease. Its Clinical Intelligence takes on the routine, high-volume work of chronic care – monitoring patients, surfacing risks, and coordinating action – so clinicians can focus on the decisions that require them. Grounded in partnerships with more than 20 leading health systems, deep EMR integrations, dedicated medical group, and experience serving a population of more than 100,000 patients, the system learns from real-world care delivery, improving as it scales. Cadence has been recognized by TIME as one of the Top 100 HealthTech Companies and by LinkedIn as a Top Startup (#4, 2025).

The Role

We're hiring a Nurse Practitioner to serve as the primary clinical point of contact for patients navigating their remote care journey.

In this role, you will lead clinical decision-making with a strong emphasis on guideline-directed medical therapy for heart failure, as well as adherence to evidence-based guidelines for type 2 diabetes and hypertension, including proactive and asynchronous medication titration based on patient vitals, symptoms, and trends. You will oversee patients, manage clinical escalations, and collaborate closely with the patient’s physician or provider to optimize treatment plans, adjust medications, and determine the appropriate level of care. This role requires a high level of clinical autonomy, strong judgment, and close collaboration with Registered Nurses and Patient Success teams to deliver timely, patient-centered, and scalable remote care.

Although this position is fully remote, it is a highly collaborative, fast-paced clinical role with clear expectations for productivity, responsiveness, and quality.

Licensure Requirements

Required: Active Compact Multi-State RN license.

Licenses must be active and in good standing at time of hire.

Schedule Requirements

This role is fully remote. Monday through Friday schedule with a core shift schedule of 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time.

What You'll Do

• Manage a panel of patients receiving remote care, making timely clinical decisions based on evidence-based guidelines for heart failure, hypertension, and type 2 diabetes.

• Deliver high-quality, evidence-based care by following established clinical protocols and workflows while applying sound clinical judgment to individual patient needs.

• Initiate and titrate guideline-directed medical therapy (GDMT) while collaborating closely with physicians, RNs, and care teams to optimize outcomes.

• Respond promptly to clinical escalations generated through remote patient monitoring, including abnormal vitals, symptoms, and laboratory results.

• Provide both synchronous and asynchronous patient care, including reviewing patient-generated health data, responding to remote patient monitoring alerts, communicating through secure messaging, and conducting scheduled virtual visits when appropriate.

• Deliver safe, efficient, high-quality care while consistently meeting established productivity and documentation expectations.

• Adapt quickly to evolving workflows, software enhancements, and operational processes as we continuously improve our care model.

• Use multiple technology platforms confidently and provide feedback that helps improve our clinical operations and technology.

• Collaborate across clinical and operational teams to identify opportunities to improve patient care, efficiency, and scalability.

• Help shape the future of a rapidly growing digital health organization where every team member contributes to building better processes—not simply following established ones.

• Are comfortable working in an environment where workflows evolve rapidly as we grow.

• Embrace change and view new technology and processes as opportunities rather than obstacles.

• Consistently meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality clinical decision making.

• Communicate proactively when they encounter barriers or identify opportunities for improvement.

• Take ownership of problems and work collaboratively to solve them.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is looking for an experienced manager to lead SOX business process compliance and help keep the trust in our financial reporting as strong as the business we’re building. As part of our SOX Compliance team, you’ll help oversee and strengthen Samsara’s global control environment, protecting the accuracy of our financial reporting and keeping us compliant as we scale. You’ll partner closely with IT and business process owners to design and implement controls, spot gaps early, and drive remediation to the finish line. We’re looking for someone who takes real ownership. You bring deep, hands-on SOX expertise, a track record of delivering projects reliably, and the confidence to run with complex work independently. If you take pride in being the person others count on to get it done right, we’d love to meet you.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in Canada.

You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

• You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.

• You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.

• You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

• Develop, lead, and execute periodic financial risk assessments, materiality calculations, and scoping of the SOX program

jobs.title: Remote Cardiology Nurse Practitioner - MS License Required
jobs.sourceName: RSS: We Work Remotely: All Other
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote

Cadence is the clinical AI company automating the treatment of chronic disease. Its Clinical Intelligence takes on the routine, high-volume work of chronic care – monitoring patients, surfacing risks, and coordinating action – so clinicians can focus on the decisions that require them. Grounded in partnerships with more than 20 leading health systems, deep EMR integrations, dedicated medical group, and experience serving a population of more than 100,000 patients, the system learns from real-world care delivery, improving as it scales. Cadence has been recognized by TIME as one of the Top 100 HealthTech Companies and by LinkedIn as a Top Startup (#4, 2025).

The Role

We're hiring a Nurse Practitioner to serve as the primary clinical point of contact for patients navigating their remote care journey.

In this role, you will lead clinical decision-making with a strong emphasis on guideline-directed medical therapy for heart failure, as well as adherence to evidence-based guidelines for type 2 diabetes and hypertension, including proactive and asynchronous medication titration based on patient vitals, symptoms, and trends. You will oversee patients, manage clinical escalations, and collaborate closely with the patient’s physician or provider to optimize treatment plans, adjust medications, and determine the appropriate level of care. This role requires a high level of clinical autonomy, strong judgment, and close collaboration with Registered Nurses and Patient Success teams to deliver timely, patient-centered, and scalable remote care.

Although this position is fully remote, it is a highly collaborative, fast-paced clinical role with clear expectations for productivity, responsiveness, and quality.

Licensure Requirements

Required: Active Compact Multi-State RN license.

Required: Active NP licensure in MS.

Licenses must be active and in good standing at time of hire.

Schedule Requirements

This role is fully remote. Monday through Friday schedule with a core shift schedule of 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Central Time.

What You'll Do

• Manage a panel of patients receiving remote care, making timely clinical decisions based on evidence-based guidelines for heart failure, hypertension, and type 2 diabetes.

• Deliver high-quality, evidence-based care by following established clinical protocols and workflows while applying sound clinical judgment to individual patient needs.

• Initiate and titrate guideline-directed medical therapy (GDMT) while collaborating closely with physicians, RNs, and care teams to optimize outcomes.

• Respond promptly to clinical escalations generated through remote patient monitoring, including abnormal vitals, symptoms, and laboratory results.

• Provide both synchronous and asynchronous patient care, including reviewing patient-generated health data, responding to remote patient monitoring alerts, communicating through secure messaging, and conducting scheduled virtual visits when appropriate.

• Deliver safe, efficient, high-quality care while consistently meeting established productivity and documentation expectations.

• Adapt quickly to evolving workflows, software enhancements, and operational processes as we continuously improve our care model.

• Use multiple technology platforms confidently and provide feedback that helps improve our clinical operations and technology.

• Collaborate across clinical and operational teams to identify opportunities to improve patient care, efficiency, and scalability.

• Help shape the future of a rapidly growing digital health organization where every team member contributes to building better processes—not simply following established ones.

These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification. Other job related duties may be assigned by management.

Who You Are

Successful Nurse Practitioners at Cadence:

• Balance exceptional patient care with strong operational efficiency.

• Are comfortable working in an environment where workflows evolve rapidly as we grow.

• Embrace change and view new technology and processes as opportunities rather than obstacles.

• Consistently meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality clinical decision making.

• Communicate proactively when they encounter barriers or identify opportunities for improvement.

• Take ownership of problems and work collaboratively to solve them.

What You Need

• Active Compact Multi-State RN license.

• Active NP licensure in MS.

• Ability to consistently work Central time hours, including later weekday coverage as needed

• 5+ years experience treating patients with chronic diseases (CHF, Hypertension, T2D) either in an outpatient or inpatient setting at a high-performing medical center.

• 3+ years of cardiology experience with a focus

• Connect information across risk assessments, incidents, KRIs, audit findings, regulatory developments, business performance, and external signals to develop an integrated view of risk.

• Investigate changes in risk indicators, challenge assumptions, identify underlying drivers, and distinguish meaningful signals from noise.

• Automate recurring analysis, data preparation, and reporting using SQL, Python, AI, and other available technologies.

• Partner across Finance, Legal, Compliance, Security, Operations, Strategy, and regional teams to understand evolving risks and translate complex analytical findings into concise, executive-ready narratives and recommendations.

LOCATION: Remote – this is a home based, virtual position. The person in this position is required to maintain residency in North Carolina or within 40 miles of the NC border.

SCHEDULE: Monday, Tuesday, Friday, and Saturday 7:00 a.m. - 5:30 p.m.

GENERAL STATEMENT OF JOB
The primary purpose of the ACCESS Member Services Specialist position is to assist individuals to access necessary and appropriate services dependent upon need and/or insurance plan. This job is subject to working holidays and holiday rotation as deemed necessary by the business.
The ACCESS Member Services Specialist duties include conducting telephonic screenings that include the collection of demographic information, providing choice among available providers, linking callers to appropriate services in a manner that is convenient for the individual, and linkage to a licensed clinician for urgent/emergent services if needed, regardless of the callers insurance plan. The ACCESS Member Services Specialist is trained in various insurance plans managed by Vaya Partners: Tailored Plan, Medicaid Direct, and State funded Services and what benefits fall within each plan for member or recipient utilization.
The ACCESS Member Services Specialist is trained to identify indicators that require clinical assistance and decision-making, and to work collaboratively with ACCESS Clinicians who handle those clinical responsibilities. The ACCESS Member Services Specialist will also handle a variety of customer services related calls including, but not limited to: confirming enrollment, accessing services, making referrals to address Social Determinates of Health needs, changing providers, providing general information and linkage to external and external programs as deemed appropriate.
This position requires a high-level understanding of North Carolina’s Medicaid system and the ability to use multiple technology systems concurrently while on a live phone call.
Note: This position requires access to and use of confidential healthcare information or protected health information (PHI) as described in laws addressing patient confidentiality, including, but not limited to, the federal HIPAA law, the Confidentiality of Alcohol and Substance Abuse Patient Records law, 42 CFR Part 2, and various state laws. As such, the individual filling this position shall be required to be trained regarding such laws and shall be required to observe those laws in his/her capacity as an employee of Vaya Partners. The individual filling this position shall also sign a confidentiality statement as an employee of Vaya Partners.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS
70% Handle telephonic requests for services, respond to member and recipient calls, and provide requested information:
The ACCESS Member Services Specialist handles telephonic requests for services by linking Vaya Partners members with contracted providers to conduct clinical assessments. For services requests, the ACCESS Member Services Specialist will inquire about the caller’s needs, review and confirm member and recipient eligibility, collect necessary demographic information, offer choice of available providers based upon the consumers request and service needs, and schedule appointments within established access time standards.
The ACCESS Member Services Specialist will inform an ACCESS manager and/or appropriate Provider Network Development staff of gaps and needs associated with trends that are detected within the services system for timely analysis and resolution.
The ACCESS Member Services Specialist will be alert to any indicators of risk for immediate referral to an ACCESS Clinician. For the other ACCESS calls, the ACCESS Member Services Specialist will obtain information about the caller’s questions or concerns and will provide resolution if possible at the time of the call or provide information about the process and expectations for the timeframe when resolution will occur.
For information calls, this position will provide information about Vaya Partners, the Vaya Partners provider network, community resources, and about Medicaid services in the State of NC. Headquarters: Remote (U.S.)

Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Discord is hiring a Director of User Experience Research to lead our research team, drive a user-centered understanding of Players (the people who use Discord), and turn that understanding into a better product. You'll own the research strategy for Discord, build and lead a team of researchers, and make sure a deep, evidence-based understanding of user needs shapes what we build before decisions are made.

You'll uncover and forecast the problems our users face and the opportunities that will add the most value to Discord. You'll deepen our understanding of every user cohort, from longtime gamers to new communities, creators, moderators, and teens. And you'll make sure what we ship results in user value for them. As Discord brings more AI-powered experiences to users, you'll ensure they're grounded in real needs and held to a clear, user-centered quality bar. You'll also modernize how research gets done, using AI to increase our speed and reach without losing rigor.

You'll partner closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Data Science, and Safety. This person will report to the VP of Product Design and Insights.

What You'll Be Doing

• Set the research vision and make research a strategic partner. Own the research roadmap across Discord, balancing foundational, generative, and evaluative work and prioritizing by user impact, business impact, and risk. Deliver clear, compelling readouts that shape prioritization and go/no-go calls, and measure research's impact on product outcomes.

• Uncover opportunities and build a shared understanding of our users. Lead foundational and generative research that surfaces unmet needs, pain points, and emerging behaviors, and use segmentation, longitudinal, and international research to understand how different user cohorts use Discord and where their needs differ, so teams design for real people instead of assumptions.

• Own usability and concept validation. Establish a consistent program for testing concepts, prototypes, and live experiences, so teams learn early whether ideas are desirable, usable, and valuable before investing heavily.

• Bring a mixed-methods lens to every major decision. Partner with Data Science to combine qualitative insight with quantitative evidence (surveys, behavioral data, experimentation) that explains both what users do and why. Define and track experience-health measures such as satisfaction, ease, and trust over time.

• Define user-centered quality for AI-powered experiences. Work with Product, Engineering, and ML partners to set quality dimensions, rubrics, and human evaluation programs that complement automated and model-based evaluation, so AI features solve real Player problems and earn user trust.

• Build and scale the practice. Hire and develop researchers and research leads, and create the career paths, rituals, and research operations they need. Equip PMs and designers to run lightweight research with the right guardrails.

• Modernize research with care and integrity. Adopt and govern AI-assisted tools for recruiting, moderation, synthesis, and insight management that help the team move faster and reach more users. Set the standard for ethical research, including rigor, bias, privacy, consent, and research with teens and vulnerable communities, in partnership with Legal, Privacy, and Safety.

What you should have

• 12+ years of experience in UX research or a closely related field (such as HCI, Psychology, or Cognitive Science), including 6+ years leading researchers and research leads

• Deep expertise across generative and evaluative methods, both qualitative and quantitative, with the judgment to turn ambiguous questions into a clear set of risks and design right-sized research for fast-moving product contexts

• A track record of research that uncovered new opportunities and changed product direction, not only validated existing plans, including usability and concept-testing programs that teams relied on

• Experience understanding and segmenting diverse user populations, ideally in consumer social, community, communication, or multi-sided platforms

• Experience researching AI or LLM-powered products, including human evaluation, rubric design, and inter-rater reliability, with a clear view of where automated evaluation helps and where it falls short

• Fluency with AI-enabled research and data tools, and sound judgment about when they strengthen research and when they weaken it

• A history of earning buy-in from executives and cross-functional partners by telling the user story and making the "so what" impossible to ignore

Our job is to tell the business which of those dollars are working, and then help decide where the next one goes.

As our Marketing Measurement lead, you'll own how Upstart answers some key questions about its marketing spend. What did each channel actually cause? How should credit be shared across the touches a borrower saw before applying? Where should next quarter's budget go? The answers decide whether a dollar of spend buys a funded loan or takes credit for one that would have arrived anyway.

We're looking for a data scientist with deep experience in causal inference and marketing measurement to be the measurement partner for our marketing, finance, and product leaders, and the person they trust to say when the evidence is strong enough to move the budget.

• Guide incrementality measurement across our marketing channels, working with the analysts who run tests in each channel on design and interpretation, so the team knows what each channel causes rather than what it gets credit for

• Apply causal inference methods when a clean test isn't feasible, so budget decisions still rest on causal evidence

• Build and maintain the attribution approach that splits credit across direct mail, digital, partnerships, and email, including channels where a borrower never clicks anything

• Turn measurement results into spend allocation recommendations that marketing and finance use to plan budgets

• Use marketing mix models alongside experiments and attribution, and work out which to trust when they disagree

• Automate recurring measurement reporting, so your time goes to interpretation and recommendations

• Mentor analysts across the team and review their measurement work

Minimum Qualifications

• 8+ years of experience in data science or a related quantitative role, much of it spent measuring marketing or growth spend

• Hands-on experience designing and analyzing incrementality tests, and a solid grasp of causal inference beyond standard A/B testing

• Working knowledge of marketing mix modeling and multi-touch attribution, including where each one breaks down

• Strong Python and SQL skills

• A track record of measurement work that changed how a marketing budget was spent

• Clear communication with technical and non-technical audiences, and the judgment to push back when the evidence doesn't support the plan

• Good judgment about when a result is solid enough to act on and when it needs another test

• Ability to work independently, scope your own projects, and drive them end to end in ambiguous situations

You Should have:

• Proven track record of coaching SDRs 1:1 and leading training across cold calls, email, and LinkedIn outreach.
