Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

The Demand Generation team brings Tailscale to the people who need it, wherever they already spend their time. For many technical folks, that's a favorite YouTube channel, podcast, newsletter, or stream. As our Demand Gen Coordinator, you'll help us show up in those places in a way that feels genuine and earns trust.

You'll find creators and outlets who share our values, build real relationships with them, and guide partnerships from first hello to final deliverable. Along the way, you'll write briefs, review content, keep projects on track, and help us learn what actually works. This role is a great fit for someone early in their career who loves both technology and the people who make content about it, and who wants room to grow.

Key Responsibilities

Creator Research & Discovery

• Research and identify creators across YouTube, podcasts, newsletters, streaming, and social media who cover self-hosting, networking, security, and developer tools.

• Evaluate creators on audience fit, content quality, technical accuracy, values alignment, and brand safety.

• Build and maintain a creator pipeline that tracks prospects, past partners, and performance history.

Outreach & Relationship Management

• Own outreach to new creators and act as their day-to-day point of contact.

• Maintain strong, long-term relationships across partnerships that often span one to two quarters with multiple deliverables.

• Partner with your manager on proposals, negotiations, and budget by preparing recommendations on rates, deliverables, and timelines.

Contracts & Partnership Operations

• Navigate internal processes for contracts, legal review, vendor setup, and payments in partnership with Legal and Finance.

• Track deliverables, deadlines, payments, and usage rights across all active partnerships.

• Keep internal stakeholders informed on partnership status, upcoming content, and blockers.

Briefs, Content Review & Facilitation

• Write clear creative briefs that turn product launches, features, and key messages into guidance creators can run with.

• Review content drafts for technical accuracy, messaging, brand guidelines, and disclosure requirements.

• Facilitate feedback between creators and internal teams, including Product Marketing, Developer Relations, Engineering, and Legal, when needed.

• QA tracking links, UTMs, and promo codes before content goes live.

Performance & Reporting

• Track and report on partnership performance, including reach, engagement, signups, and pipeline influence.

• Share learnings and recommend where to invest next based on what's working.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work with Community Programs, Developer Relations, Social, and Lifecycle Marketing to amplify creator content and connect creators with launches, events, and campaigns.

What We Are Looking For

• 1-3 years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, sponsorships, partner marketing, demand generation, or adjacent fields.

• Hands-on technical experience, such as running a homelab, self-hosting services, or tinkering with networking, so you can follow technical content and spot inaccuracies.

• Experience reaching out to and building relationships with external partners, creators, or vendors.

• Strong written communication skills, with the ability to write briefs that are clear, concise, and easy to act on.

• Exceptional attention to detail and a quality-assurance mindset; you catch broken links, missing tracking, or off-brand messaging before anything ships.

• Ability to manage several partnerships at once with high reliability and end-to-end ownership.

• Comfortable collaborating across Marketing, Legal, Finance, and Product to move multi-stakeholder projects forward.

• Experience using LLMs and AI tools to speed up research and routine operational work.

• Genuine curiosity about the people who create technical content and the communities that watch, read, and listen.

Nice to Have

• Experience at a developer-focused, infrastructure, security, or B2B SaaS company.

• Active presence in technical communities

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team:

At Upstart, our Applied AI team's mission is threefold:

•
Agent Platform: Build and support the platform that makes it straightforward for non technical users across Upstart to build, launch, and operate AI agents (voice/chat/text) reliably.

•
Borrower and Applicant Assistant Orchestration: Build the orchestration layer behind a unified personal assistant that shares context across specialized agents, giving applicants and borrowers a cohesive, assistant-like experience.

•
Borrower-Connected Internal Workflows: Improve internal operational workflows that directly connect to applicant and borrower experiences, making them faster, smarter, and more efficient.

As Principal Engineer, LLM you will serve as a technical pathfinder and force multiplier for this team and the product squads we partner with. Rather than owning internal developer-tooling infrastructure or training foundation models from scratch, your mandate is to compress the time between an ambiguous idea and a reliable, user-facing AI system, while raising the applied AI bar across every squad you touch.

This role operates on an explicit 80/20 charter :

•
0-to-1 Product and Architecture Pathfinder (~80%): Rapidly prototype high-ambiguity bets across our agent platform, cross-agent context orchestration, borrower-facing assistant experiences, and internal workflows. Partner directly with Product and Design to validate non-deterministic UX, establish clean architectural patterns, and hand off battle-tested evaluation contracts for engineering squads to scale.

•
AI-Native Engineering Catalyst (~20%): While dedicated internal teams own Upstart's broader AI developer tooling and software-factory initiatives, you will serve as a visible practitioner on the product side. You will lead by example with agentic coding workflows and tight verification harnesses, partner with our internal tooling teams as an early adopter ("customer zero"), and help product squads adopt higher-leverage ways of working.

Because AI systems are non-deterministic, user experience is part of the architecture. Whether you are designing cross-agent handoffs, borrower-facing assistant flows, or internal operational tools, you will navigate real-world trade-offs across latency, unit economics, reliability, and user trust, and push back constructively when a simpler deterministic approach is the right call.

How you’ll make an impact

•
Deliver durable evaluation contracts, not throwaway handoffs: Treat prototype code as disposable proof of concept, and hand off to engineers what they actually need to build production services with confidence: golden datasets, automated evaluation harnesses, documented failure-mode maps, latency/cost benchmarks, and clean architectural blueprints.

Appointment Setter, Wealth Without Wall Street (Remote)
Read this first. It might save you an hour.
The base on this job is $2,000 a month. It's real, it's guaranteed, and it won't pay your bills by itself. We're not going to pretend it will.
If that made you close the tab, good. We just saved each other some time.
If it made you lean in, here's why the people who win this seat don't care about the base.
30,000 people are sitting in our database. Every one of them raised their hand to learn how to build passive income and become their own bank. Almost nobody is calling them.
That's your seat.
Who we are: Russ Morgan and Joey Muré have been teaching business owners how money actually works since 2015. They wrote the book on it, literally. And they don't just teach it. Every month they publish their own passive income in public. Most money teachers won't show you their numbers. Ours put theirs out every month.
What you'll actually do

You'll call warm leads. No bought lists and no cold calling.

• About 200 new leads come in every month from our webinars and referrals.

• Behind them are 30,000 people who know our name and haven't heard from us in a while. Some raised a hand this morning and some a year ago.

• You book qualified calls for our closers, and you follow up like it matters, because it does.

Here's the catch. These are business owners, and plenty of them have read the book. Read a script at them and they'll eat you alive. You have to actually understand what you're talking about.
That's the part no other sales job will give you. While we pay you to make these calls, you learn the same system our clients pay to learn: how to stop handing your money to the banks and how to build income that keeps coming in. You'll use it on the phone, and then you'll use it in your own life.

The math (check it yourself)

• $2,000 monthly base

• $50 to $100 for every appointment that shows

• About $300 for every sale that closes from your bookings

20 closes a month is $6,000 in commission. Add the $2,000 base and you're at $8,000 before appointment pay. That's what this seat is built to produce.
You won't get there in your first month. The early stretch is leaner while you learn the system and build your pipeline. Setters who win treat that stretch as an investment. Setters who wash out treat it as a paycheck.
Where this goes: We're filling closing seats too. They go to whoever earns them, and the fastest way to earn one is from this chair.

You'll fit if:

• You've spent 1 to 2 years on the phone somewhere real: solar, door to door, appointment setting, insurance, high-ticket, inside sales or home services

• You can hold your ground with a business owner who pushes back, 50 times a day

• You can make 150 dials without hunting for a shortcut

• When you get coaching, tomorrow's call sounds different

• You follow up without being reminded

• You've worked in a CRM (HubSpot is a plus)

• You have reliable internet and a quiet, professional home office

Please don't apply if:

• You want the base to carry you and see commission as a bonus

• You've hopped between 3 or more sales jobs in the last 2 years

• You go quiet when a buyer who's read the book pushes back

• You need someone watching you to stay on the phone at 4pm

What winning looks like here: you hit your dials every day, call new leads fast, book qualified appointments, use coaching the same day you get it and own your number.

Compensation This is a performance-based opportunity that rewards consistency and execution.

• $2,000 monthly base, plus $50 to $100 per held appointment and about $300 per closed sale

• Typical on-target earnings of $6,000 to $10,000 a month once you're ramped

• Warm inbound leads, with zero cold lists

• Fully remote

• Real onboarding and ongoing coaching from experienced sales leaders

• A clear path into closing and sales leadership

• You learn the wealth system our clients pay to learn, on the clock

• An established company that has been teaching this since 2015

Actual earnings depend on individual performance and are not guaranteed.

Instacart's Detection Engineering team sits at the core of our Security organization, building and operating the systems that identify, surface, and respond to threats across one of North America's largest grocery technology platforms. We operate with a detection-as-code mindset: everything we build is versioned, tested, and deployed through repeatable pipelines. We care deeply about reducing noise, improving analyst efficiency through automation and SOAR, and continuously evolving our coverage as the threat landscape shifts.

If you're energized by hard forensic problems, enjoy translating attacker TTPs into durable detection logic, and want to help shape the future of a growing security function, this role is for you.

At Clover, the Business Enablement team leads our technological advancement while ensuring robust security and compliance. We deliver user-friendly corporate applications, manage complex data ecosystems, and provide efficient tech solutions across the organization. Our goal is simple: we make it easy for the business to do what’s right for Clover.

We’re hiring an Engineering Lead to own the technology behind Clover’s acquisition journey, from the public website and lead generation through telesales, broker workflows, and enrollment. You will understand how the operation works, shape the product and technical approach, lead a small team, and help build the systems yourself.

This role focuses on autonomy and engineering-led delivery: take an important business goal, understand the people and data involved, choose a practical approach, ship useful increments, and own the result. You will also manage approximately two to three engineers, give them clear scope, and develop their judgment. Expect roughly 60% hands-on technical work and 40% management, planning, and work with business partners.

Your charter includes our content management systems, telesales technology, member app, and public surface area including our enrollment forms and customer data and public analytics platforms. You will work through the whole chain, from a data source or API to what an agent or prospective member actually experiences.

As an Engineering Lead, Growth, you will:

• Own technical direction and delivery for acquisition systems, including the public website and assets, telesales, broker workflows, and enrollment experiences.

• Work directly with sales, growth, marketing, and operating partners to understand the business problem, choose useful increments, and agree how their value will be measured.

• Connect analytics, leads, customer data, CRM, and operating workflows. Make data flows, ownership, and failure behavior understandable and dependable.

• Build and improve software personally. Use AI in development, investigation, analysis, prototypes, and useful product capabilities, and evaluate the result against actual behavior.

• Lead and coach a small engineering team. Make scope and staffing decisions, give direct feedback, and stand behind credible delivery commitments.

• Make pragmatic choices about architecture, vendors, and existing capabilities. Keep a focused solution moving while preserving engineering quality and control of important integration points.

• Partner with IT on the operation and support of sales tools, and with Product and our special projects teams on discovery, dependencies, and business change.

• Observe how prospective members, brokers, and sales staff use the systems. Use that evidence to improve the experience and the operation.

Success in this role looks like:

• First 90 days: You understand the acquisition journey and existing systems, have a clear first delivery plan, and have shipped an increment that improves our users’ experience. Your engineers have clear ownership, and business partners understand the next commitments.

• First six months: The team has landed a new telesales stack, and other agreed acquisition priorities, including the ongoing growth demands of a five star Medicare Advantage plan. Data and tools are improving the actual sales workflow, and the result is visible in agreed operational and acquisition measures.

You should get in touch if:

• You are a strong production software engineer who has led work end-to-end and can reason across application, integration, data, and user-experience boundaries, especially in public-facing contexts.

• You have managed and developed engineers while remaining directly involved in building. You enjoy the scope of an enduring small team.

• You have strong product instincts and can translate a commercial or operating goal into a useful technical plan with measurable results.

• You have built systems involving customer data, CRM, sales or acquisition workflows, public web and content management experiences, or similarly interconnected operations.

• You use AI deeply in your own engineering work and have practical experience building or integrating AI-backed capabilities. You can explain how you check the result.

• You work well with business partners, make tradeoffs clear, and can move work forward when the initial request is ambiguous.

Benefits Overview :

• Financial Well-Being : Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.

• Physical Well-Being : We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare.

Description
Backed by Y Combinator and Sequoia Capital, Magic has spent 10+ years connecting fast-growing businesses with top remote talent.

This is a full-time, in-house, permanent role with full benefits. You'll be a Magic employee owning client relationships on the company's behalf, not a VA placed with a client. Our clients are busy founders and executives who need remote workers to deliver real ROI, and they need a strategic partner to make that happen. You're not here to answer tickets. You're here to protect revenue, grow accounts, and turn happy clients into loud advocates. The pace is live and constant: client calls, escalations, and account health across a real portfolio, every single day, with no handoffs and no delays.

Shift: US Eastern hours, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM ET, Monday to Friday (a 9-hour shift), with occasional early or late calls for West Coast clients or urgent situations. Fully remote, Philippines-based.

Key Responsibilities

•
Guard your book of business: own a portfolio of accounts sorted by size, health, and growth potential, and hold 90%+ gross revenue retention (GRR) and 110%+ net revenue retention (NRR). Those are the numbers you're graded on.

•
Spot at-risk accounts before clients say a word. Start renewals 60–90 days out, and get save plans moving early.

•
Launch every new client fast: kickoff call within 24–48 hours of signing, then Magic's 30-60-90 day onboarding framework, with a success plan tied to their business goals and an intro to their remote worker.

•
Host quarterly business reviews (QBRs) clients actually look forward to: data-driven, strategic, action-oriented. Become the trusted advisor to founders and C-suite, and multi-thread across each client so one champion leaving doesn't sink the account.

•
Hunt expansion opportunities and make the business case before anyone asks.

•
Surface the story in the data: track churn risk and expansion signals, keep HubSpot clean, send a monthly portfolio health report (retention, NRR, CSAT, NPS, QBR completion), and own every escalation from intake to resolution.

Qualifications & Technical Requirements

• 3+ years of B2B customer success or account management experience, juggling a portfolio of accounts at the same time

• Direct ownership of revenue retention and expansion targets across the full customer lifecycle from onboarding to renewal

• Background in SaaS/tech, outsourcing/staffing, professional services/BPO, or marketplace platforms

• HubSpot experience used daily for pipeline and account health (intermediate-to-expert Salesforce or a similar CRM also works)

• Intermediate-to-advanced Excel or Google Sheets: pivot tables, VLOOKUP/INDEX MATCH, dashboards, trend analysis

• Real US market experience: you know US business culture, SMB challenges, and how executives like to communicate

• Strong written and spoken English, good enough for daily conversations with US-based C-level and Director clients

• A professional home office: high-speed internet (50+ Mbps), a headset, and a quiet space

You treat customer success as a revenue function, not a help desk. You own the outcome, so you don't wait to be told an account is wobbling; you've already spotted it, and your save plan is moving. You're comfortable in a room with a founder or a C-suite exec, and you can plow through a messy escalation without losing the relationship. You read the data, find the story, and walk into every QBR with a point of view. You pitch expansion because the numbers back it up, not because a quota told you to. When something breaks, you adapt, get the right people in the room, and keep going.

Application + pre-qualifying questions → HR interview (45 min) → 24-hour reflection period → Panel Interview with Senior CSMs → interview with CS Director → Final Interview with the Head of Sales & CS → Job Offer

What's In It For You
₱60,000–₱80,000 gross per month, permanent and full-time, fully remote (Philippines). HMO coverage after regularization, 12 vacation days and 10 sick days a year, 13th month pay, SSS, PhilHealth, and PAG-IBIG. We offer paid training and promote from within: top CSMs move into Senior CSM, Team Lead / CS Manager, and CS Director roles.

We're an ambitious, driven team that plows through obstacles instead of waiting for perfect conditions. There's no hierarchy and no politics: you can talk to anyone, on any team, about anything. We respect each other's time, and we actually like working together. Magic is backed by Y Combinator and Sequoia Capital, with more than 10 years of connecting top remote talent with fast-growing businesses and 2,000+ remote workers worldwide.

You will lead Rubrik's global GSI technical organization, with two integrated charters that work as one system.

• Global Solutions - Architects build the play for named global GSIs: joint offers, reference architectures, blueprints and certification strategy with partner COEs. They work with Product on what is coming next and feed roadmap gaps back.

Why you will love this job :

• A category we created. Cyber resilience started here, and the market now follows our lead.

• Partners are a strategic priority, with executive sponsorship from the top and a seat at the table.

• 12+ years in solution architecture, pre-sales engineering, partner engineering or a related technical go-to-market role.

• 5+ years leading teams, including managing managers, with a global footprint across regions.

• Experience designing KPIs, scorecards and operating cadences that drive behavior and outcomes.

• Comfort with Salesforce and data-driven management of pipeline and deals.

jobs.sourceName: RSS: We Work Remotely: Sales and Marketing
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote - USA

ABOUT THE ROLE

AI is rewriting how every company works, and everyone is racing to figure out how to secure it. We have, and we need someone to take it to market.

The AI Security Sales Executive is a quota-carrying sales role dedicated to Abnormal's AI Security suite: five products built to help customers govern AI, secure AI, and defend against rogue AI. You will work alongside the Account Executives who know our customers best: joining land motions, driving AI Security expansion across our 5,000+ customers, and running focused outbound to win net new logos in the largest enterprises. Early on, most of your focus will be expansion. This is a sales role for someone who can carry a number and go as deep technically as our best engineers when a conversation demands it.

The timing matters. Abnormal is growing quickly, with more than 5,000 customers and over 30% of the Fortune 500 trusting us to protect their people. AI security now comes up regularly in customer conversations at the executive level, and customers already trust our behavioral AI to solve it. You will have real say in how this category gets sold.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Own AI Security in your region. Carry the AI Security quota and run the sales cycle from first conversation through close.

• Drive expansion across our customer base. Lead upsell campaigns into customers who already trust Abnormal, and join land motions where AI Security belongs in the conversation.

• Run focused pipeline generation. Build a targeted, strategic outbound motion to open net new logos in the largest enterprises, partnering with the core AE where a relationship exists. Quality over volume.

• Partner with Account Executives. Work alongside the core team in your region, equip them to carry AI Security conversations, and step in on the deals that matter most.

• Go deep on the technology. Hold your own with security and platform teams on AI governance, agent security, and cloud security when a customer needs more than a standard pitch.

• Run point on design partner conversations for products still in early availability, working closely with product leadership to shape these deals and bring the right resources to the table.

• Shape the product and the playbook. Work directly with Product and R&D leadership, including our co-founder and CTO, and feed what you hear in the field back in a fast loop as the suite matures from early availability to GA.

• Build AI Security expertise across the sales team, in addition to closing.

• Stay current as the suite evolves. Availability and depth will shift quickly, and you will keep pace.

WHAT YOU'LL SELL

Abnormal's AI Security suite includes five products, each at a different stage of availability:

• AI Governance: Discovers your AI, uncovers shadow AI, and shows who's using what and at what cost.

• AI Cloud Security: Detects and contains AI cloud breaches using behavioral AI and honeypots.

• AI Employee Guardrails: Lets employees use AI without leaking data or triggering unintended actions.

• AI Agent Security: Inventories an organization's AI agents and ensures they behave as intended.

• AI Security Workbench: Lets security teams use AI to run investigations with Abnormal's models, without guardrails.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS RIGHT NOW

Every security vendor is staking a claim in AI security. Abnormal has earned real credibility here through eight years of behavioral AI investment and a track record protecting email for thousands of customers. That trust is an advantage today, not a permanent one, and this role exists to make sure we capitalize on it while the window is open.

For the right person, that means owning a brand-new motion at the center of a fast-growing company, working directly with executive and product leadership, and building a track record as one of the people who defined how this category gets sold.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• 5+ years of quota-carrying sales experience, primarily selling into Enterprise accounts, with a proven record of personal quota attainment and winning new business.

• Hands-on experience selling an AI product, with enough technical and product depth to run the sales cycle as the expert and give our product team credible feedback.

• A record of selling in security or closely adjacent infrastructure.

• Technical depth and curiosity: comfort discussing AI architecture, cloud security concepts, and how behavioral models work, in enough detail to earn trust with technical buyers.

• A consultative, challenger style, paired with the hunter instincts to run strategic outbound into new logos.

• Comfort operating in ambiguity. The suite and the motion for selling it are still evolving, and much of the playbook will be written by whoever takes this role on.

• Strong cross-functional instincts. You will partner closely with Account Executives, Sales Engineering, and product leadership, and you will work autonomously between those touchpoints.

NICE TO HAVES

• D

jobs.description:
Headquarters: Canada - Remote

Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform. Since inception, we've been focused on building a delightful, world-class experience that empowers physicians to deliver phenomenal care to patients.

Customer support has been the same job for twenty years: a queue, a ticket, an SLA, a closed case. That's ending, fast. Over the next 6–9 months, AI will take on more of the routine, repetitive cases at Elation. That doesn't shrink the human role — it builds on it. The work becomes product intelligence: shaping how AI handles conversations, holding the customer-trust moments that need real judgment, and turning patterns into priorities Engineering delivers.

We're hiring Technical Support Specialists to anchor that shift: people who don't just close tickets, but build the systems that eliminate them, design how AI handles conversations, and turn customer patterns into product priorities.

You might’ve been the person on a team who builds the dashboards, automations, or workflows that make everyone else better from a Support, Implementation, CS Ops, or Analyst seat. Now you want to formalize that work as the role itself. As a Technical Support Specialist, you'll bring empathy and judgment to the cases that need it most, own the quality of AI-driven solutions in your domain, and synthesize patterns that influence Product and Engineering roadmaps. We hire for judgment, taste, and curiosity, not process adherence. The bar isn't how many cases you closed ; it's how much you reshaped the conditions under which cases happen .

Role and Responsibilities

• Use Good Judgment to Solve Cases. Own customer escalations with cases that genuinely require seasoned judgment, the ones AI can't safely close. Build and protect customer trust in moments that matter.

• Build and own AI quality. Configure AI within Elation's stack (intents, knowledge sources, escalation rules), build lightweight external automations, and own the quality of AI outputs in your domain.

• Synthesize and partner with Product/Eng. Produce formal weekly and monthly insights, participate in roadmap conversations with Product Development teams, and mentor Associates on their build and synthesis work.

What success looks like in your first 6 months

• Shipped 3–5 AI solutions

• A monthly drumbeat of synthesized insights that Product and Engineering act on, with visible impact on customer experience or a measurable drop in case volume

• Owns a measurable case-volume reduction in your domain by making cases not happen, not by closing them faster

• You question default workflows instead of just executing them, and you ship more by removing work, not just doing more of it.

• You build with AI to make yourself and the teammates around you faster — automating triage, drafting responses, prototyping internal tools, and turning one-off builds into reusable patterns Associates can run with .

• Mentors Associate teammates on AI builds and pattern synthesis

Professional Qualifications

• 0-4+ years of relevant experience inSupport, Implementation, CS Ops, embedded data analyst, or AI/automation tinkerer in any field.

• A concrete portfolio of things you've built or shipped: prompt-engineered systems, dashboards, automations — with evidence of outcomes

• Strong customer-facing communication and trust-building skills

• Pattern recognition and synthesis muscle

• AI-native default. Reaches for AI tools first, treats ambiguity as the work rather than a blocker, and wants to learn how to configure and supervise these systems — not just use them

• A deep desire to drive results for our customers, with high ownership over the outcomes you own

• Curiosity and natural problem-solving instincts

• An instinct to raise the bar for the teammates around you — teaching others to build and synthesize, not just modeling it yourself

Show us your work

Along with your application, in a cover letter send us:

• 2–3 things you've built or shipped that changed a metric or outcome — what you made, who it was for, why did you need to do it, and what changed.

About US
We are a 7-8 figure direct-to-consumer (DTC) brand portfolio operating across the US and international markets, led by our flagship brand GODA. We build and scale high-demand beauty, fragrance, and personal care products shipped directly to hundreds of thousands of customers. At our scale, customer trust, fast problem resolution, and post-purchase loyalty are everything. When a customer experiences friction, whether a delayed delivery, a subscription billing question, or a public escalation, this role turns a frustrated buyer back into a loyal brand advocate.

The Role
Standard customer support reacts to incoming tickets. As Executive Resolution & Outbound Retention Specialist, you prevent churn and protect brand reputation. Sitting inside our Outbound, Retention & Reputation team, you are the senior voice customers speak with when high-priority issues arise, and the proactive specialist who reaches out by phone and email to recover failed payments, retain subscribers, and grow verified 5-star reviews.

What You'll Be Doing
BBB & High-Priority Escalation Ownership

• 24-Hour SLA Resolution: Monitor, respond to, and resolve incoming BBB complaints and public review escalations within a strict under-24-hour response window.

• Phone-First De-Escalation: Conduct calm, empathetic outbound calls to frustrated US customers, diagnose what went wrong in Shopify/Commslayer, and deliver fair, tailored solutions (express reshipments, Loop exchanges, store credit, or approved refunds).

• Official Portal Closure: Draft clear, non-defensive written responses inside the BBB Business Portal and follow up directly with customers until they confirm satisfaction and close the case.

• Cross-Functional Fulfillment Coordination: Partner directly with our Order Fulfillment team to expedite stuck, delayed, or partially fulfilled orders tied to escalated cases.

Outbound Retention, Payment Recovery & Reputation Growth

• Failed Payment & Win-Back Calls: Execute daily outbound phone calls and tailored email follow-ups to help subscribers update failed payment methods and keep active deliveries running smoothly.

• Subscription Save Outreach: Connect with at-risk or canceling subscribers to understand friction points and offer flexible alternatives (skips, cadence adjustments, or product swaps).

• Trustpilot Review Generation: Reach out to verified happy GODA customers via phone and email to encourage authentic 5-star reviews on Trustpilot and public storefronts.

• Escalated Email Queue: Handle sensitive email threads escalated from Inbound Customer Care involving dispute/chargeback threats, billing misunderstandings, or repeat delivery issues.

Tracking, Compliance & Root-Cause Feedback

• 100% Case Hygiene: Maintain accurate, real-time logs across Commslayer, Shopify, and the BBB resolution tracker so zero open cases fall through the cracks.

• Upstream Prevention: Tag recurring escalation drivers (carrier delays, renewal confusion, SKU defects) and share weekly insights with the CS Manager and Process Experts to fix root causes.

Must-Haves

• Proven Voice + Email Experience: 2+ years in DTC e-commerce customer support, escalations, retention, or account resolution, with strong comfort making daily outbound phone calls and writing tailored escalation emails.

• US-Overlap Availability: Able to work a full-time shift overlapping with US daytime/afternoon hours to reach US customers live by phone.

• Composed, Persuasive Communication: Clear, warm, natural English (spoken and written) with the emotional intelligence to de-escalate upset buyers without sounding scripted or defensive.

• High Follow-Through Discipline: You never mark a case finished until the resolution is confirmed by the customer and properly logged in external portals.

• Tech-Stack Fluency: Hands-on comfort working daily in e-commerce order dashboards, helpdesks, cloud VoIP dialers, and Google Sheets trackers.

Strong Advantages

• Reputation & Dispute Experience: Prior hands-on management of Better Business Bureau (BBB) complaints, Trustpilot outreach, or chargeback/dispute prevention.

• DTC Core Tools: Direct experience with Shopify, Commslayer (or Zendesk/Gorgias), Loop Returns, Aircall/RingCentral, and subscription platforms (Recharge, Skio, or Stay AI).

• Subscription Brand Background: Previous experience supporting a high-volume DTC beauty, fragrance, wellness, or personal care subscription brand.

Instant No's

• Phone Hesitation: You prefer hiding behind email macros rather than picking up the phone to speak directly with an upset customer.

• Copy-Paste Mindset: You rely on rigid policy scripts instead of listening to the customer's actual issue and tailoring the fix.

• Loose Documentation: Forgetting to update trackers or close portal responses. Accurate records protect both the customer and our brand rating.

Headquarters: Remote, APAC

Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California. Learn more at bitwarden.com .

Bitwarden is committed to delivering the best possible experience for users when accessing and managing their sensitive information. The Customer Success team helps customers and all Bitwarden users meaningfully engage with Bitwarden products while proactively planning for user growth, service availability, and to ultimately achieve their desired outcome. Team members have excellent product knowledge, superb technical skills, stellar grammar, attention to detail, and the ability to explain complicated things simply. Success is measured in diligence, precision, transparency, and customer assessment.

Bitwarden is looking for a server and cloud enthusiast, with experience in both communicating about and deploying these technologies. You will become a Bitwarden product expert and handle business inquiries regarding our products, troubleshooting technical issues, completing systems integrations, and ensuring customer satisfaction.

This is an all-remote team and we’re looking for someone located in the APAC region.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Functioning as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Bitwarden and the entire product portfolio

• Leading proof-of-concept trials with customers, new deployments, and/or integrations of Bitwarden containerized services

• Advising customers on industry best practices for the full stack of Bitwarden

• Working with enterprise customers to solve issues and/or look ahead to identify solutions to situations they may face in the future

• Providing superb guidance and assistance for each business prospect or customer’s implementation of Bitwarden, integration with the rest of their technology stack, and general security

• Collaborating with Sales, Engineering, and Product associates

• Assist in planning, developing, and presenting live technical product demonstrations showcasing best practices scaled to the customer’s use-case

• Document and share customer feedback from collaborative sessions to help the Bitwarden team exceed expectations

WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN

• Excellent English and grammar

• Excellent problem-solving skills (you might not know all the answers but you know how to find and communicate the solutions)

• Project planning, including collaborative and individual time management

• A passion for supporting your team members, growing together (technical ability and emotional intelligence), and sharing your knowledge with all

• A strong sense of empathy and the ability to advocate for others

• A passion for helping Bitwarden users

• Experience from a previous technical position (e.g. Systems Engineer, Implementation Engineer, DevOps Engineer, IT Infrastructure Engineer, etc). Equivalent education or demonstrable skills may be accepted

• Ability and desire to work remotely

Familiarity with several of the following areas/technologies is preferred:

• Bitwarden

• Linux, Windows, and macOS

• Docker, Kubernetes, and Podman

• NFS and CIFS

• Bash and PowerShell

• Active Directory, LDAP, Google Workspace, Azure Entra ID, Jumpcloud, Cloudflare and Okta

• GCP, AWS, and Azure

• Android and iOS

• GitHub

• NGINX

• SQL

• TCP/IP

• DNS

• HTTP

• SMTP

• SSO implementation and best practices (SAML and OpenID Connect)

• Integrating SCIM solutions

• TLS/SSL and PKI

• RESTful APIs

WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

• Meeting with our Recruiting Manager

• Interview with Manager of Implementation Engineering

• Interview with Implementation Engineering team members

• Interview with Chief Customer Officer & VP of Customer Success

A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US

• Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.

• Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software.

• We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world.

• Learn and grow. Take on new challenges with the support of your team, and join our #growth-club to continue personal and professional development.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bitwarden-implementation-engineer-customer-support-apac

GaggleAMP is a profitable SaaS company that has led the employee-advocacy category for over a decade. We're hiring our second Account Executive: a full-cycle closer who builds their own pipeline, qualifies hard, sells on value and holds price.

What you'll own

• A $1M new-ARR quota. At our deal sizes, that's roughly 2 to 4 new customers a month. Marketing sends some leads, but about half of your pipeline will come from your own prospecting.

• Qualification. Confirm fit, find the person who controls the budget and build a value case before you invest your time. Walk away quickly when those aren't there.

• Value-led discovery. Tie our impact to the buyer's own numbers, such as pipeline generated from social or paid spend we offset, before price comes up.

• Price. We don't discount. You sell at list price and let poor-fit deals go.

• An honest forecast. Deals move forward when the buyer does something real, and your CRM stays current.

• Clean handoffs with Marketing, Implementation and Customer Success.

Why join

• Real ownership of your pipeline, your qualification calls and your deal strategy.

• A value story that wins and real pricing power, plus a sales framework you'll help shape.

• A profitable company. No venture clock, no death-march growth targets, and a category we've led for over a decade.

How you work
• You disqualify without drama. A clean no is a good outcome, and you can tell us about a recent deal you walked away from.

• You build value cases in dollars from what the buyer tells you. When a buyer has no hard number, you can still put a dollar value on reach and traffic.

• You tie price to value instead of defending it or offering a discount.

• You advance deals on buyer commitment, not because a call went well or a demo got booked.

• You understand the importance of getting to the decision maker to close deals.

• You get leverage from your tools. You use AI tools (such as ChatGPT or Claude) and prospecting tools (such as Apollo) every week to sell smarter.

Location Fully remote within the United States.

Requirements

• You have carried and closed a new-business quota, running deals yourself from discovery to signature.

• You are familiar with AI tools and use them in your selling every week.

• Medical, Dental & Vision insurance (after 30 days).

• Matching 401K (after 6 months).

• Join an exciting and dynamic company with a strong leadership team and culture.

• Grow professionally by gaining powerful experience managing relationships in the digital marketing space.

• Have the opportunity to contribute and directly impact the growth and direction of the company you work for.

About Mixpanel

Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com .

About the Customer Digital Experience Team

Customer Digital Experience sits within the technical arm of Mixpanel's Customer Success organization.

Our sharpest focus is the digital-only segment: thousands of companies with no proactive account coverage. Some have technical resources available to them, but that support is entirely reactive. It answers the ticket and solves the problem in front of it. Nobody is watching for the customer who implemented and then never built a report, or the account whose usage has been sliding for a month. Our job is to be proactive,, and everything we build should be as automated as possible, without a human initiating it.

Our programs run across the full customer base and are not one-size-fits-all. We build flows that branch and adapt by segment, tuning the content, timing, and channel for who's receiving them. An onboarding flow for a digital-only customer carries the whole experience; the version reaching an account with a dedicated team is tuned to complement what that team is already doing. Same underlying program, deliberately different execution, continuously optimized based on what each segment responds to.

We're close to the data and to the technical reality of how customers implement and use Mixpanel. We're not guessing at what customers are doing; we can see it, and we build against it. This is a small, new team standing up a new function. The playbook isn't written yet; we're writing it together.

About the Role

As our Digital Adoption & Lifecycle Manager, you'll own the communications that drive adoption, retention, and expansion across Mixpanel's customer base, with our digital-only customers as the sharpest test of whether the programs work. You'll design lifecycle programs triggered by real behavior: a team that just implemented but hasn't built their first report, an account whose query volume dropped for three straight weeks, a power user hitting the edge of their current plan. Then you'll write the emails and in-product messages that move them forward.

This is a builder's role, not a maintainer's role. You'll define the segmentation, write the copy, set up the triggers, instrument the measurement, and then argue with the data about what to change.

It's also a deeply collaborative one. You'll work hand in hand with our Customer Success Digital Programs Manager, sharing a roadmap and dividing the work. You'll partner with Marketing on the overall email calendar so our lifecycle sends and their campaigns aren't competing for the same inbox. You'll support adoption initiatives coming out of Product, turning a launch into something customers actually try. And you'll take cues from customer-facing teams about what's landing and what isn't. Very little of this job happens alone.

You'll also help define what agentic customer success looks like at Mixpanel. The scaled programs we build today are rules and triggers; the ones we build next will involve AI agents that can interpret a customer's situation, decide what that customer needs, and act. We're early here and we don't have the answers. We want someone who is already experimenting, who already has opinions about where agents help and where they break trust, and who wants to shape how this gets built.

If you like clean handoffs and finished systems, this isn't it. If you want to build the thing from zero and own the number it moves, read on.

• Build the lifecycle communication program end-to-end across onboarding, adoption, retention, and expansion, from strategy through copy, build, launch, and iteration

• Create programs that serve the full customer base while working hardest for digital-only customers, and decide where messaging should differ for accounts with a dedicated team

• Simplicity - Be like Einstein: “Everything should be made as simple as possible, but no simpler.”

Celonis grew up with the private sector: Deutsche Telekom, Mercedes-Benz, Uniper and three quarters of the DAX companies rely on Celonis Process Intelligence. About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic’s Life Sciences team is working to make Claude a useful partner across biology and drug development, so that promising science can reach patients sooner. Genetic medicines are one area where we see real potential, particularly for diseases with few or no treatment options.

Chemistry, manufacturing, and controls (CMC) often sets the pace in this field. We’re hiring a CMC & Manufacturing Lead to bring deep technical expertise to our team. You’ll guide CMC strategy across a range of genetic medicine technologies, work closely with external partners, and help our researchers and engineers make Claude useful for real CMC work.

Much of today’s CMC practice was built for products made at scale for large populations. You’ll help work out what better approaches could look like for smaller ones, including platform processes, faster testing, and ways to carry knowledge from one product to the next.

If you have deep experience manufacturing genetic medicines and want to explore how AI can help accelerate the way they’re developed, we’d love to hear from you.

• Guide CMC and manufacturing strategy for genetic medicines, from early development through clinical supply

• Provide technical oversight of externally conducted process development, formulation, analytical development, fill-finish, stability, and release testing, with phase-appropriate specifications and control strategies

This role runs the internal posture engine — the risk register, critical control monitoring, evidence, audit operations and GRC tooling. It keeps risk state current so the Lead and the Risk Committee decide from accurate data in the Risk Dashboard and reporting. Drata is the register of record. Named owners close gaps; this role keeps the register, evidence and audit operations current.

Planning

• Operate the risk register from the Security Programme threat model: populate, track treatment, record acceptance decisions, follow up owners, and run the exceptions register.

• Keep the ISMS and security policy library current as part of audit readiness. Draft security standards when commissioned by the Lead.

• Run Drata as the control and evidence system — Statement of Applicability, framework crosswalk and automation.

Execution

• Run critical control monitoring: health check-ins, drift flags and Drata automation. Route drift to the SOC. Maintain the evidence file for Lead assessments and independent internal audit.

• Feed threat-assessment findings into the register and confidence ratings. Track which required assessments are current.

• Lead audit coordination and preparation: ISO 27001 and SOC 2 logistics, ISMS readiness, team prep, management-review pack, and customer due-diligence questionnaires.

• Coordinate the control register for external testing (red team, tabletop, pentest). Run security awareness and weekly alerts.

Tracking and evaluating performance

• Track residual risk, exceptions and gap-closure against appetite. Exceptions expire and are reported; the underlying requirement stays in force.

• Report register state and evidence health so the Lead and Risk Committee work from one view.

Achieving overall defined performance

• Be accountable for a current, defensible posture engine — register, evidence and audit operations.

• Ensure Drata collects evidence continuously, with automated evidence where coverage exists.

Qualifications

• Hands-on experience running a risk register, control library and audit cycle (ISO 27001 and/or SOC 2).

• Comfortable with GRC platforms (Drata or equivalent) and turning monitoring into evidence.

• Proven ability to coordinate audits and customer questionnaires with named control owners.

• Precise written work; register and Statement of Applicability quality matters.

• Strong stakeholder management with control owners and auditors.

• CISA, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Auditor, or equivalent professional certification.

Cadence is the clinical AI company automating the treatment of chronic disease. Its Clinical Intelligence takes on the routine, high-volume work of chronic care – monitoring patients, surfacing risks, and coordinating action – so clinicians can focus on the decisions that require them. Grounded in partnerships with more than 20 leading health systems, deep EMR integrations, dedicated medical group, and experience serving a population of more than 100,000 patients, the system learns from real-world care delivery, improving as it scales. Cadence has been recognized by TIME as one of the Top 100 HealthTech Companies and by LinkedIn as a Top Startup (#4, 2025).

The Role

We’re hiring a Clinical Navigator (Medical Assistant) to deliver virtual chronic care support for Medicare patients enrolled in Cadence care programs.

Clinical Navigators deliver proactive, patient-centered outreach and follow-through. Depending on program needs, this role includes structured patient check-ins, coaching and goal-setting, care coordination to close gaps in care, and addressing barriers such as access to resources, transportation, or medication refills. Clinical Navigators document patient interactions in the Cadence platform and collaborate closely with the clinical team to escalate concerns and coordinate next steps, ensuring patients feel supported, informed, and engaged throughout their care journey.

• Help patients execute personalized care plans and achieve their goals by providing education and coaching focused on behavior modification, nutrition, physical activity, and self-management strategies using evidence-based techniques such as motivational interviewing and SMART goals.

• Conduct comprehensive assessments of patients' health status, lifestyle behaviors, nutritional habits, and readiness to change.

• Educate patients on disease management, medication adherence, symptom recognition, and prevention strategies, and execute care delivery tasks in accordance with Cadence clinical policies and established protocols, under appropriate clinical supervision.

• Disciplined in documentation and follow-through, with the attention to detail required for accurate clinical records in a remote environment.

• Reliable and consistent in schedule adherence, with the interpersonal communication skills to build trust with patients over the phone.

• Comfortable working independently in a remote, fast-paced environment with evolving workflows, and tech-savvy enough to navigate and troubleshoot multiple systems simultaneously while keeping patients engaged.

• Comfortable using AI-assisted clinical tools (such as Gemini or Open Evidence) to support patient interactions and surface relevant clinical context, while maintaining clinical judgment as the primary guide for every patient decision.

Cadence is the clinical AI company automating the treatment of chronic disease. Its Clinical Intelligence takes on the routine, high-volume work of chronic care – monitoring patients, surfacing risks, and coordinating action – so clinicians can focus on the decisions that require them. Grounded in partnerships with more than 20 leading health systems, deep EMR integrations, dedicated medical group, and experience serving a population of more than 100,000 patients, the system learns from real-world care delivery, improving as it scales. Cadence has been recognized by TIME as one of the Top 100 HealthTech Companies and by LinkedIn as a Top Startup (#4, 2025).

The Role

We’re hiring a Clinical Navigator (Licensed Practical Nurse) to deliver virtual chronic care support for Medicare patients enrolled in Cadence care programs.

Clinical Navigators deliver proactive, patient-centered outreach and follow-through. Depending on program needs, this role includes structured patient check-ins, coaching and goal-setting, care coordination to close gaps in care, and addressing barriers such as access to resources, transportation, or medication refills. Clinical Navigators document patient interactions in the Cadence platform and collaborate closely with the clinical team to escalate concerns and coordinate next steps, ensuring patients feel supported, informed, and engaged throughout their care journey.

Schedule

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States. Standard working hours are Monday through Friday, from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM or 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM in the Pacific time zone.

What You’ll Do

• Conduct outbound telephonic patient outreach and provide one-on-one coaching and support to patients managing chronic conditions, including but not limited to type 2 diabetes, hypertension, and cardiovascular disease.

• Help patients execute personalized care plans and achieve their goals by providing education and coaching focused on behavior modification, nutrition, physical activity, and self-management strategies using evidence-based techniques such as motivational interviewing and SMART goals.

• Conduct comprehensive assessments of patients' health status, lifestyle behaviors, nutritional habits, and readiness to change.

• Educate patients on disease management, medication adherence, symptom recognition, and prevention strategies, and execute care delivery tasks in accordance with Cadence clinical policies and established protocols, under appropriate clinical supervision.

• Monitor patients' progress, adherence to treatment plans, and health outcomes through regular check-ins and remote monitoring tools.

• Document patient interactions, outcomes, and follow-up plans in the Cadence platform; identify barriers to care (including social needs) and connect patients with resources or internal support pathways.

• Collaborate in real time with clinicians and patient support teams using tools such as our Cadence Platform, Google Workspace, and Slack, and contribute feedback to improve workflows in a fast-moving, change-oriented environment.

These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification. Other job related duties may be assigned by management.

Who You Are

• A clinician who thrives at the intersection of rigorous care standards and a care delivery model that is still being built.

• Disciplined in documentation and follow-through, with the attention to detail required for accurate clinical records in a remote environment.

• Reliable and consistent in schedule adherence, with the interpersonal communication skills to build trust with patients over the phone.

• Comfortable working independently in a remote, fast-paced environment with evolving workflows, and tech-savvy enough to navigate and troubleshoot multiple systems simultaneously while keeping patients engaged.

• Comfortable using AI-assisted clinical tools (such as Gemini or Open Evidence) to support patient interactions and surface relevant clinical context, while maintaining clinical judgment as the primary guide for every patient decision.

• Biased toward action - you bring clinical authority to every interaction, make the call when it counts, and take ownership of outcomes.

• An active compact multi-state LPN/LVN license in the state where you currently reside is required.

• At least 5 years of clinical experience as a Licensed Practical Nurse is required.

• Remote work readiness (including stable high-speed WiFi) is required.

• An active CA state LVN license is required

• Fluency in Spanish is preferred.

We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Customer Agent who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

Are you passionate about driving customer success? Addicted to solving problems? So are we. We are looking for a customer-driven problem solver at Sezzle. With a fun, genuine, and empathetic voice, you will be troubleshooting and writing clear and concise instructions to solve questions about utilizing Sezzle. You have excellent written and verbal communication skills. You are dependable, resourceful, and get joy from going beyond to make customers successful.

What You'll Do:

• Provide clear, prompt, detailed, empathetic, and customer-oriented support to our consumers

• Showcase passion and connection with the nooks and crannies product

• Act as an advocate for our customers, report and act on observed areas for improvement in our product or processes

• Actively seek solutions to customer needs, communicate trends to leadership, and suggest innovative solutions on behalf of the customer - experience

What We Look For:

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Fluent in written and spoken English

• Proven success in a fast-paced support environment

• Exceptional verbal and written communication skills to provide clear, articulate and kind customer support in technical instructions via phone support, email, and live chat

• Able to efficiently manage multiple tasks at the same time and utilize personal judgment to take initiative

• Driven to dig into the details of a system or process to solve customer problems

• Displays a passion for what you do while upholding personal and corporate integrity

• Excitement to learn new technologies and help customers succeed

• 3+ years of customer support experience

• Fluent in written and spoken English and Spanish (a third language is a pre)

• Fixed shift, based in Central Standard Time

• Competitive salary, bonus structure

Compensation and Benefits

• Salary: $3.000.000 COP monthly

• Benefits:

• Remote role

About You:

• You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

• You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things

• You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

Business context usually gets fragmented across CRMs, documents, dashboards, and people's heads. GrowthBricks brings that context together so agents and people can make decisions and execute effectively across the sales, marketing, and product stack.

About GrowthBricks

GrowthBricks is a shared business brain for GTM teams and AI agents.

It brings together the context that usually lives across CRM, docs, dashboards, tools, and people’s heads: who we sell to, why customers buy, what matters now, what we tried, and what worked. Agents and people use that context to decide what to do next and execute across the GTM stack.

GrowthBricks is a new project at JetMinds, backed by JetBrains.

About the role

We’re looking for a hands-on Founding Tech Lead to build GrowthBricks from zero.

You’ll work directly with the product founder and own the technical side of the product: architecture, core systems, integrations, and the agent layer.

The core challenge is turning fragmented, changing business context into reliable memory and agent actions across tools and measuring whether those actions actually drive business outcomes.

You’ll write a lot of the early code yourself, make the key technical decisions, and shape the product as we learn what works.

What you’ll work on

• Design the core architecture: business context, agents, tools, integrations, and feedback loops.

• Build agentic workflows that can reason over company context and act across CRM, sales, marketing, and product systems.

• Build context extractors from GTM team artifacts like sales calls, emails, internal documents, CRM state, marketing campaigns, etc.

• Work on prompting, context management, memory, tool use, and orchestration.

• Connect GrowthBricks to the existing GTM stack rather than rebuilding everything around it.

• Decide where to use MCP, APIs, frameworks, or third-party tools and where a custom solution is worth it.

• Prototype fast, discard weak ideas, and turn the useful ones into product primitives.

We expect that you

• Are a strong hands-on engineer who enjoys zero-to-one work.

• Have built with LLMs, agents, or agentic workflows used by real people, and improved them based on failures, evaluations, and user feedback.

• Understand how context, prompting, tools, and agent behavior fit together.

• Can design backend systems, APIs, data models, and integrations.

• Are comfortable making decisions before all the answers are known.

We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

The Advertiser Optimization team is the decision-making engine of Instacart's $1B+ ads business. We own the systems responsible for Bidding, Pacing, Budgeting, Targeting and advertiser-facing recommendations - converting stated advertiser goals into real-time auction actions. Our mission is to maximize realized Advertiser Value by deciding when to participate, how much to bid, and how fast to spend, all while carefully balancing User Experience and Platform Revenue.

We are looking for an Applied Research Scientist II with a strong quantitative background to join our team. In this role, you will apply your expertise in operational research, mathematics, statistics, economics, or a related field to help build and refine the algorithmic systems that power how Instacart's advertising marketplace operates. You'll work alongside a talented team of scientists and engineers, contributing to production systems that have real, measurable impact on a scaled ads platform. If you're excited by the intersection of rigorous quantitative thinking and large-scale engineering, this is the role for you.

About the Job

• Develop and evaluate models and algorithms for ads bidding, pacing, and budgeting, applying your training in operational research, mathematics, statistics, economics, or a related quantitative discipline to solve complex marketplace problems at scale.

• Collaborate closely with senior scientists, engineers and product managers to translate well-defined marketplace questions into mathematical formulations, implement analyses and prototypes, design experiments, and interpret results using large-scale data.

• Contribute to production systems through algorithm implementation, validation, and monitoring, progressively taking ownership of well-scoped projects from initial hypothesis through measurable impact.

• Operate in a fast-paced, constantly evolving environment where the ads marketplace shifts quickly — you'll need to balance rigor with speed, and thrive when priorities change and new challenges emerge.

• Communicate assumptions, findings, and limitations clearly to both technical and cross-functional partners, helping the team make better decisions through transparency and analytical clarity.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

• PhD in operations research, mathematics, statistics, economics, or a related quantitative discipline, with a strong foundation in at least one of the following areas: optimization, probability, statistical modeling, econometrics, or control theory.

• Proficiency in Python and SQL, with demonstrated ability to translate quantitative concepts into analyses, algorithm implementations, and experiments.

• Strong analytical and communication skills, including the ability to explain assumptions, methodologies, results, and limitations to both technical and cross-functional audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

• 2+ years of software engineering experience, particularly in applying quantitative methods to production systems.

• Familiarity with ads systems, auction theory, or related marketplace optimization problems.

• Experience working with large-scale data pipelines and real-time decision systems.

• Familiarity with machine learning techniques and applying machine learning in production systems.

jobs.description:
Headquarters: US - Remote

Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform. Since inception, we've been focused on building a world-class technology solution that creates an experience of delight and ease for physicians, and that our users love.

Every signed customer agreement at Elation passes through a final review before billing and onboarding begin. That review confirms what the customer signed matches what we set up in Salesforce: the right products, quantities, prices, and dates. When it's done well, customers get billed correctly from day one and our finance and customer success teams avoid costly cleanup later.We are looking for a Contract Operations Associate to join our Business Systems Team on a contract basis and own a share of these reviews. You'll work from clear checklists and procedures, use AI-assisted review tools, and partner closely with the specialists who own this process. This is a great fit for someone early in their career who is detail oriented, enjoys getting things exactly right, and wants hands-on exposure to how a SaaS company runs its revenue operations.

What You'll Do

Contract Review & Verification

• Own a daily review queue of signed deals awaiting final approval, starting with new customer agreements, downgrades, and simple add-ons (adding a product or seats), then expanding to renewals and other deal types as you ramp.

• Confirm the signed order form is complete : both the customer and Elation have signed and dated it, and you identify the official execution date.

• Check that key dates line up across the order form, the Salesforce opportunity, and the quote (execution date, close date, and contract start date), and that add-ons end on the same date as the customer's existing contract.

• Reconcile the quote against the order form line by line: products, quantities, terms, unit prices, and totals, including confirming that unchanged products and removed products are recorded correctly.

• Verify approvals and required data : discounts have a documented approval, required fields are filled in, and the customer account is a real, active practice rather than a trial.

• Correct routine issues directly in Salesforce (e.g., date fields or account details) when the procedure allows it, then advance the deal to Closed Won.

• Confirm downstream handoffs fired after approval, such as the customer's billing record and onboarding project being created, and flag anything that didn't.

Partnering with Sales & Customer Success on Corrections

• Return deals that need fixing to the account executive or customer success manager who owns them, with a clear, specific note: what doesn't match, where you found it (order form page, quote line, field), and what correct looks like.

• Follow corrections through to completion : track returned deals, check that the fix is right when they come back, and re-review promptly so customers aren't left waiting on billing or onboarding.

• Prioritize with deal owners during busy periods like month end, communicating which deals are blocked and what's needed to close them on time.

• Spot repeat issues by rep, team, or deal type and share them with the team, so we can improve training, Salesforce guardrails, and error messages and prevent the same mistake next time.

Resolving Open Questions with Stakeholders

• Bring questions to the right person with full context : the deal link, what you checked, what's unclear, and your best guess at the answer. Start with the team's operations specialist, then partner with Deal Desk, Customer Success leadership, Finance (billing and revenue reporting), or Salesforce administrators as directed.

• Escalate anything outside the checklist rather than making judgment calls on your own, such as contract exceptions, non-standard discounts, unusual date requests, or large and custom agreements.

• Track every open question until it's resolved , keeping the deal owner updated so nothing stalls silently in the queue.

• Capture the answer once a question is settled, adding it to the procedure or FAQ so the next reviewer doesn't have to ask again.

Tools, Documentation & Continuous Improvement

• Run AI-assisted review tools first on each deal, then complete the manual checklist and confirm or correct the tool's results; your corrections help improve the automation.

• Log issues and root causes in our ticketing system for any deal that didn't pass cleanly.

• Flag gaps or confusing steps in our procedures; your feedback directly shapes the documentation and training for future reviewers.

What You Bring

• Attention to detail : you notice when two documents don't match, and you double-check before calling something done.

Elation Health is deeply committed to helping independent primary care practices take better care of their patients. About Driversnote

Driversnote is a profitable, product-led SaaS company based in Copenhagen that helps over 4.5 million users simplify mileage tracking, with paying customers in 100+ countries. Our core product is a freemium mobile app, often paired with our iBeacon hardware for precise, automated mileage logging, and backed by a powerful web platform.

We’re a close-knit team of 50 working together across design, mobile and web development, marketing, support, sales and customer success. We’ve quadrupled our ARR in the last three years by staying focused on delivering real value to our users, and we’re now expanding from B2C into B2B, building advanced features for teams.

Our Customer Success and Support team is locally anchored in Denmark, Canada and Australia. Customers get help in their own time zone from people who know their market, its rules and how its businesses work.

The role

As Customer Support Specialist, you’re the person our North American users and business customers reach when they need help. You solve their problem, explain it clearly and leave them more confident using Driversnote.

AI already answers many of our simpler questions. That means your time goes to the tickets where a person makes the difference: tracking issues, account and billing questions, and teams setting up for their drivers.

Success looks like this after your first six months:

• Customers rate your replies highly, and you reply fast within your hours

• You’re the go-to person in your time zone for questions about tracking and our iBeacon

• Troubleshooting tracking issues and explaining the fix in a clear, friendly way

• Sharing what you learn with the team and helping each other out across time zones

The pace can be high, so you stay focused, keep an overview and give every customer a good experience, even when several need you at once.

What you’ll do

• Answer customers: Help customers by email, chat and phone for individual users and business teams.

• Get hands-on with new business areas, such as checking drivers’ insurance documents for business customers.

What we’re looking for

• Based in Canada, with the right to work here

• 1+ years in customer support, ideally for an app or SaaS product

• Near-native English, written and spoken

• French, written and spoken
